source_original_texts: 地面：离港滑行路线为“YELLOW”,进港滑行路线为“GREEN ”。飞行员每次滑行前应当事先熟悉具体滑行路线编号代表 的进离港标准滑行路线。落地可能因为更换跑道使用反向跑 道的进场滑行图中的路线，进近准备时提前熟悉滑行路线图，如果机组脱离跑道后，有疑问请及时向管制员证实转弯方 向。
core.source_text_en: The departure taxiway is designated as "YELLOW", while the arrival taxiway is "GREEN". Pilots must familiarize themselves with the specific taxiway number before each run, as itcorresponds to the standard taxiway for both departure and arrival. During approach preparation, they should review the taxiway chart in advance. If the crew needs to deviate from the runway, they must promptly confirm the turn direction with air traffic control.

广州白云.chinese_core_preview:
离港滑行路线为“YELLOW”,进港滑行路线为“GREEN ”。

广州 机位919R 不建议单发滑行。

yellow11滑行线在Q到T61,Q和M滑行路线很近，没有地 面标识，滑行时注意观察避免滑错。

滑行道换向，摒弃旧滑行惯性，严防逆行。

运行方向切换时仔细听通播，留意跑道、滑行道状态, 飞行准备务必复习本场新滑行路线。

无需复诵PDC。

飞行员每次滑行前应当事先熟悉具体滑行路线编号代表 的进离港标准滑行路线。

落地可能因为更换跑道使用反向跑 道的进场滑行图中的路线，进近准备时提前熟悉滑行路线图，如果机组脱离跑道后，有疑问请及时向管制员证实转弯方 向。

跑道运行规则：向北运行：RWYO1L主要用于进场；RWYO1R 主要用于离场；RWYO2L主要用于离场；RWYO2R 主要 用于进场；RWY03进、离场混合运行。向南运行：RWY19R 主要用于进场；RWY19L 主要用于离场；RWY20R 主要用于离场；RWY20L 主要用于进场；RWY21 进、离场混合运行。

进位跟引导车，地面指挥员为引导车司机，快到位时 应控制速度等司机下车引导。

公司对广州落地飞机有单发滑行要求，某些较短窄停 机位进位时注意转弯速度，如J3上的停机位等。

02L跑道起飞时地面常指挥T61在Y19前等，由于绕滑的 滑行道设计特殊性，中方航图与杰普逊AMM航图标识有差异，杰普逊AMM航图标识Y19标识不显示，有时会误导机组T61 前方的滑行道是Y20完成右转才是Y19，经与地面管制证实如 果发布T61在Y19前等，机组需要在T61上等待，避免错过等 待线。

广州O2 R落地，M滑行，T64滑行道前无标志牌，仅有地面滑行标志，实际T64标志牌在T64滑行道之后，容易 引发误解。

广州T3，939附近机位，管制给推出指令，可以推 开，推到R3，跑道01R。机务可能只推到大概正对838到939 之间的位置。这个时候应提醒机务往前拉一点，尽量满足推 到R3上。因R3，R4，R5连接处有点滑行区域没有标注，在推 出过程中管制指令和机务行为有时候不够统一，务必多留心。建议设计特定推出程序，或者给出明确清晰推出指令。

着陆航空器应尽可能使用顺向且靠近接地点的第 一或第二快速脱离道退出跑道，需要使用第三条快速脱离道 及以远道口脱离跑道时，机组应在与塔台建立首次联系时进 行通报。

绕滑距离变长，起飞前预留充足地面滑行时间。

注意根据fly Smart修改单发加速高度。

广州涉及航线距离较长，飞机起飞重量大，从T3滑行 至01R/19L地面滑行时间长，且道面坡度起伏和转弯多，易 造成刹车温度高，导致航班延误或起飞后机轮温度超限情况，请机组注意。

离地后自动脱波联系进近，具体频率由放行给出。

SID中如有速度限制，可尝试申请取消，否则应遵循。

东南亚方向离场可能指挥直飞P50加入X66临时航 路到BIGRO。

早出港航班需参考实际通播和放行按需选择离场跑道。

广州早出港航班，向北起飞，有时管制指挥使用跑道 02R起飞。需要穿越跑道02L，需要注意穿越跑道之后正对着 的是P13并不是02R跑道头。Y18为跑道02R跑道等待点，转向 Y时需要注意，Y18并非为Y尽头，注意滑行速度，避免滑过。

杰普逊航图里没有单发离港程序，需要提醒外籍参考 EFB航图。

外籍广州机场特点中，标注单发程序还未启用，需要 修改现在已开始执行单发程序，参照EFB航图。

进场后段会雷达引导，计算好高距比。

会指挥速度180到8海里，尽量满足避免造成间隔不够。

广州01L落地后，指挥GREEN 1时，由E左转T3 时，左 侧无t3灯牌，且地面也无转入t3的图标，只有一个转入T4的 图标，且T4处有灯牌，容易造成误解。

如航图复飞高度与管制指挥不一致时，以管制指挥为 准。

01L落地后，滑行道E J23到J14段有较明显上坡，建议 在此之后执行单发滑行。

夏秋季有台风影响，带来大范围的强风、暴雨、雷 暴天气。

将W19航线MASGU-MABAG-OGABI-NOMAR 航段调整为MASGU-UPMIP-ATKAV-OLPAB-NOMAR供华东方向落地广州航班及飞跃 珠三角航班使用。

E/F/D/T3/T4为高冲突区，加强观察，指令及时复诵确 认。

机场繁忙且相邻机场较多，严格遵守管制指挥，避免 造成冲突。

新程序调整，多个程序更名，限制高度涉及更改，注 意参阅航图对照MCDU数据。

单发程序：广州机场跑道01L/R、02L/R、03从06.11日起 开始实施单发程序，请机组注意。
广州白云.english_core_preview:
No need to recite PDC

The departure taxiway is designated as "YELLOW", while the arrival taxiway is "GREEN". Pilots must familiarize themselves with the specific taxiway number before each run, as it corresponds to the standard taxiway for both departure and arrival. During approach preparation, they should review the taxiway chart in advance. If the crew needs to deviate from the runway, they must promptly confirm the turn direction with air traffic control.

Typically, aircraft take off from 01R/19L or 02L/20R, and land from 01L/20R or 02L/20R.

When the lead vehicle approaches, the ground commander acts as its driver. Upon reaching the target position, the commander must control the speed and guide the driver to disembark.

The company requires single-engine taxiing for aircraft landing in Guangzhou, with particular attention to turning speed when approaching shorter and narrower aprons, such as those on the J3 apron.

At Guangzhou O2 R, the M taxiway is operational while the T64 taxiway lacks signage, with only ground taxiway markers visible. The T64 sign is actually positioned behind the taxiway, which may cause confusion.

The aircraft automatically disengages from the wave contact after leaving the ground and approaches, with the specific frequency provided by the air traffic control.

If the SID has speed restrictions, you may apply to cancel them; otherwise, you must comply.

Departing from Lanzhou may be directed to fly directly to P268 or P118, then join the X64 temporary route to QP. Departing from Southeast Asia may be directed to fly directly to P50, then join the X66 temporary route to BIGRO.

For early departure flights, select the departure runway based on real-time air traffic updates and clearance requirements.

The W19 route segment MASGU-MABAG-OGABI- NOMAR will be adjusted to MASGU-UPMIP-ATKAV- OBLAP-NOMAR for flights landing in Guangzhou and those flying over the Pearl River Delta region bound for East China.

After entering the field, radar guidance will be used to calculate the altitude-to-range ratio.

The vessel shall maintain a speed of 180 to 8 knots, ensuring sufficient spacing to avoid insufficient intervals.

After the Guangzhou 01L aircraft landed, when directing the GREEN 1 aircraft, the E left-turn signal for T3 was absent on the left side, and no ground indicator showed the approach to T3. Only an approach to T4 was indicated, with a signal light at T4, which could easily cause confusion.

The departure taxiway is marked as "YELLOW", and the arrival taxiway is marked as "GREEN".

In case of discrepancy between the flight plan's re-flight altitude and the air traffic control command, the latter shall prevail.

After landing at 01L, the taxiway from E J23 to J14 features a steep incline. We recommend performing a single-engine taxi after this section.

On Yellow 11 between Q and T61, taxiways Q and M are close together with no ground markings. Please keep a sharp lookout while taxiing to avoid turning onto the wrong taxiway.

Taxiway T2 between C and D will be closed from 25 October to 23 December due to Fangbai Intercity Railway and Line 22 construction. Taxiway layout and taxi routes at this aerodrome will be significantly adjusted. When operating northbound, Taxiway T1 will be used east to west and Taxiway D south to north. When operating southbound, Taxiway E will be used north to south. Flight crews are reminded to:

Observe the revised taxiway directions, avoid relying on previous taxi habits, and strictly prevent wrong-way taxiing.

Expect longer taxi distances and allow sufficient ground taxi time before departure.

Exercise increased vigilance in the high-conflict areas E/F/D/T3/T4, maintain enhanced visual lookout, and read back all ATC instructions promptly and correctly.

When the direction of operations changes, carefully monitor ATIS for runway and taxiway status, and review the updated aerodrome taxi routes during flight preparation.

During summer and autumn, typhoons exert influence, bringing widespread strong winds, heavy rainfall, and thunderstorms.

The airport is highly busy with multiple adjacent airports, requiring strict compliance with air traffic control directives to prevent conflicts.

Adjust the single-shot acceleration altitude according to the fly Smart modification.

The new procedure involves adjustments to multiple programs and name changes, with height restrictions requiring modifications. Please refer to the air chart for MCDU data verification.

New airport runways pose risks of misidentification, misdirection, or land to wrong way. It is mandatory to stay vigilant, enforce standardized announcements and cross-checking procedures, especially during low visibility, rain, or night operations, to prevent runway confusion.

Noise reduction procedure: Refer to Rule 2.21.2.

PBN single-engine departure procedures for Runways 01L/R 、02L/R and RWY03 are applicable. The JEPPESEN chart does not include single-engine departure procedures; Foreign pilots should refer to the EFB chart.

Pressure relief procedure: Refer to EFB for details.

Radio failure procedure: Refer to Section 2.22.5 of the airport regulations for the general procedure for radio communication failure.

source_records.source_original_text_en: New airport runways pose risks of misidentification, misdirection, or land to wrong way. Crews must stay vigilant, enforce standardized announcements and cross-checking procedures, especially during low visibility, rain, or night operations, to prevent runway confusion.

departure.english_preview:
No need to recite PDC

The departure taxiway is designated as "YELLOW", while the arrival taxiway is "GREEN". Pilots must familiarize themselves with the specific taxiway number before each run, as it corresponds to the standard taxiway for both departure and arrival. During approach preparation, they should review the taxiway chart in advance. If the crew needs to deviate from the runway, they must promptly confirm the turn direction with air traffic control.

Typically, aircraft take off from 01R/19L or 02L/20R, and land from 01L/20R or 02L/20R.

When the lead vehicle approaches, the ground commander acts as its driver. Upon reaching the target position, the commander must control the speed and guide the driver to disembark.

At Guangzhou O2 R, the M taxiway is operational while the T64 taxiway lacks signage, with only ground taxiway markers visible. The T64 sign is actually positioned behind the taxiway, which may cause confusion.

The aircraft automatically disengages from the wave contact after leaving the ground and approaches, with the specific frequency provided by the air traffic control.

If the SID has speed restrictions, you may apply to cancel them; otherwise, you must comply.

Departing from Lanzhou may be directed to fly directly to P268 or P118, then join the X64 temporary route to QP. Departing from Southeast Asia may be directed to fly directly to P50, then join the X66 temporary route to BIGRO.

For early departure flights, select the departure runway based on real-time air traffic updates and clearance requirements.

The departure taxiway is marked as "YELLOW", and the arrival taxiway is marked as "GREEN".

In case of discrepancy between the flight plan's re-flight altitude and the air traffic control command, the latter shall prevail.

On Yellow 11 between Q and T61, taxiways Q and M are close together with no ground markings. Please keep a sharp lookout while taxiing to avoid turning onto the wrong taxiway.

Taxiway T2 between C and D will be closed from 25 October to 23 December due to Fangbai Intercity Railway and Line 22 construction. Taxiway layout and taxi routes at this aerodrome will be significantly adjusted. When operating northbound, Taxiway T1 will be used east to west and Taxiway D south to north. When operating southbound, Taxiway E will be used north to south. Flight crews are reminded to:

Observe the revised taxiway directions, avoid relying on previous taxi habits, and strictly prevent wrong-way taxiing.

Expect longer taxi distances and allow sufficient ground taxi time before departure.

Exercise increased vigilance in the high-conflict areas E/F/D/T3/T4, maintain enhanced visual lookout, and read back all ATC instructions promptly and correctly.

When the direction of operations changes, carefully monitor ATIS for runway and taxiway status, and review the updated aerodrome taxi routes during flight preparation.

During summer and autumn, typhoons exert influence, bringing widespread strong winds, heavy rainfall, and thunderstorms.

The airport is highly busy with multiple adjacent airports, requiring strict compliance with air traffic control directives to prevent conflicts.

Adjust the single-shot acceleration altitude according to the fly Smart modification.

The new procedure involves adjustments to multiple programs and name changes, with height restrictions requiring modifications. Please refer to the air chart for MCDU data verification.

Noise reduction procedure: Refer to Rule 2.21.2.

PBN single-engine departure procedures for Runways 01L/R 、02L/R and RWY03 are applicable. The JEPPESEN chart does not include single-engine departure procedures; Foreign pilots should refer to the EFB chart.

Pressure relief procedure: Refer to EFB for details.

Radio failure procedure: Refer to Section 2.22.5 of the airport regulations for the general procedure for radio communication failure.

core.text_zh: 执行 VTBS 20R RNP 进近需要注意。ATKIN 之后转 5 边的 航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165,intercept final course 20R,report established.”注意 管制是要求先建立20R RNP 的五边，而不是许可 RNP 进近,注意 证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以 RNP20R，容易造成能量大，机组注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP 进近不 允许执行“高截获”程序。
core.text_en: When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

core.text_zh: 02L进近 常指挥保持3 边航向，控制前后机距离，之后 指挥直飞BATEM 或ABVER，在引入02LRNP 进近计划时MCDU会提 示选择VIA BATEM 如果没有选择VIA 计划上看不到BATEM 点。
core.text_en: During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

core.text_zh: 02L落地后使用F W 跑道外等，使用W 穿越跑道Straight ahead D4 换频 121.95会直接给停机位和滑行路线 例如 S123 D 滑行 G 前等，继续滑行 T18 或 T19 进位。机场细则中规定：02L/20R落地后不允许在快速脱离道停留去等待滑行指令，若无 指令，02L 落地后应延 F、W、02R 外等，20R 落地后应延 F、Z、20L外等。
core.text_en: For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

core.source_text_en: For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

english_core.text_en: When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

部分机位推出过程中会临时停下给出启动发动机的指 令，后续会继续牵引飞机，机组应该注意听清指令，不要盲 目刹车，否则有导致剪切销断裂的风险。

如预计经过沥青道面，不建议单发滑行。

滑行道不平整如果 N1-50%时仍无法滑出，需要拖车。

现场/签派频率：BANGKOKBLUEPORT(BANG-KOKBLUEPORT)，频率129.050，如果我们的机组人员在素万那普机场有任何疑 问，例如需要TOBT/TSAT/停机位方面的信息，或者需要飞行计 划方面的协助，或需要提出特殊要求，请通过此频率联系他 们。

地面运行时，应确保 Mode S 应答机可用，并且打开应 答机（例如：非STAND-BY或 OFF位置），设置给定的Mode A 代 码（离港飞机，来自于收到的放行许可；进港飞机，继续原代码 直至完全在停机位停好）。

为防止可能的干扰，对离港飞机，直到收到进入或者对 正跑道指令才打开 TCAS；对于进港飞机，直到脱离跑道再关闭。

H6与 H3,H5与 H2为同一条滑行道注意识别。

在加油的时候，素万那普机场要求不要上客。如果必须在加 油的时候上客，要先通知机场准备消防车。具体可询问春秋机务！。

有减噪程序，除非影响飞行安全，在1900-2300UTC时间 内不得使用大反推。

曼谷的 s126机位的进位引导经常跳变，会出现瞬间从 2 米调到 0 然后出现 stop，ok 后又会跳变出数字，有滑过或者未 滑行到位的风险，机组和机务都多次遇到此类情况。

为减少跑道占用时间，飞行员应确保在收到起飞 许可后能立即开始起飞滑跑。

离地自动脱波119.25。

使用20L 跑道起飞时容易滑错，因为 E1，E2非常 近，而且E 滑行道有延伸段去货机坪，请机组务必注意。

01跑道会使用 B12离场。

19 号起飞离场一般用Selka1J 离场，起飞后可能 会指挥取消限制直飞Selka，然后可能指挥直飞 SAV。

常用程序：RNAV进场。

雷达水平间隔最小5nm，在 BKKTMA、BKKCTR和素万那普 ATZ内，间隔可能减小到 3nm。

航图新增Z 进近程序为主用程序，数据库也有变化，提 示机组注意阅读对应进场图中Warning 中的说明，避免未经 ATC 许可转向五边加入进近程序。

执行 VTBS 20R RNP 进近需要注意。ATKIN 之后转 5 边的 航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165,intercept final course 20R,report established.”注意 管制是要求先建立20R RNP 的五边，而不是许可 RNP 进近,注意 证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以 RNP20R，容易造成能量大，机组注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP 进近不 允许执行“高截获”程序。

02L进近 常指挥保持3 边航向，控制前后机距离，之后 指挥直飞BATEM 或ABVER，在引入02LRNP 进近计划时MCDU会提 示选择VIA BATEM 如果没有选择VIA 计划上看不到BATEM 点。

02L落地后使用F W 跑道外等，使用W 穿越跑道Straight ahead D4 换频 121.95会直接给停机位和滑行路线 例如 S123 D 滑行 G 前等，继续滑行 T18 或 T19 进位。机场细则中规定：02L/20R落地后不允许在快速脱离道停留去等待滑行指令，若无 指令，02L 落地后应延 F、W、02R 外等，20R 落地后应延 F、Z、20L外等。

我司常停在Satellite-1 卫星厅-1，素万那普有PDC，确 认PDC 之后无需复诵，直接联系地面请求推开指令。停机位对应 的地面频率可以在AMM 图上看到。

ILS Z 01 BS690 mandatory 1600 RNP 02L BS670 mandatory 1600 ILS Z 19 BS790 mandatory 1600 RNP 20R BS770 mandatory 1600。

三跑道运行，原01R/19L,跑道更名为 01/19跑道，原01L/19R 跑道更名为02R/20L 跑道。第三跑道02L/20R 将会 作为非精密进近跑道使用，可以使用RNP 进近程序。

南面进出港:19 用于起飞和落地，20L 用于起飞，20R 用于落地。北面进出港:01用于起飞和落地，02R 用于起飞，02L用于落地。

曼谷进近只给出进场STAR 程序，不告知跑道，虽然 通波只告知一条进近跑道，但仍有可能使用通波没有列出的跑 道，机组建立五边之前务必证实跑道和进近方式。

导航设施：SVB 台因迁移长期不工作，已无 VOR 进近程序，盲降测距仪与跑道头位置有误差，避免不稳定。

本机场实施 RNP 进近程序期间，ATC 指挥可能与程 序设计逻辑存在差异，请以公司飞行操作通告为准。

巡航时在曼谷区域，近期多触发 NAV ADS-B RPTG 1+2 FAULT,NAV BKUP SPD FAULT，随后出现两侧GPS PRIMARYLOST，机组应当提前熟知技术通告，飞行全过程中知晓最低安全高度，按技术通告处理。

通讯失效后按航图或机场细则执行。

空域异常繁忙，间隔较小，可能加入等待与标准等待或有出入注意证实。

军演频繁，常涉及改航路，请对照飞行计划检查。

减噪程序：见机场细则。

释压程序：见放行单。

无线电失效程序：机场细则及杰普逊手册有具体实施 方法。
曼谷素旺那普.english_core_preview:
On-site/Dispatch Frequency: BANGKOKBLUEPORT (BANG-KOKBLUEPORT), Frequency 129.050. Should our crew members have any inquiries at Suvarnabhumi Airport—such as requests for TOBT/TSAT/landing slot information, flight planning assistance, or special requests—please contact them via this frequency.

During ground operations, ensure the Mode S transponder is operational and activated (e.g., not in STAND-BY or OFF position). Set the designated Mode A code (for departing aircraft, use the code from the received clearance; for arriving aircraft, maintain the original code until fully parked in the apron).

To prevent potential interference, TCAS should remain activated for departing aircraft until receiving the go-to or go-around command, and deactivated for arriving aircraft until the aircraft has left the runway.

Note that H6 and H3, as well as H5 and H2, are on the same taxiway.

Suvarnabhumi Airport prohibits boarding during refueling. If boarding is necessary, notify the airport in advance to prepare fire trucks. For details, contact Spring Airlines Maintenance.

Noise reduction procedures are in effect. The use of heavy reverse thrust is prohibited between 1900 and 2300 UTC unless it compromises flight safety.

At Terminal S126 in Bangkok, the approach guidance system frequently exhibits abrupt switching: it may instantaneously shift from 2 meters to 0, then display "Stop"; after pressing "OK," the number may switch again, posing a risk of overshooting or failing to reach the correct position. Both flight crew and ground maintenance personnel have encountered this issue on multiple occasions.

Common procedures: RNAV

To minimize runway time, pilots must ensure they can begin taxiing immediately upon receiving the takeoff clearance.

Automatic wave separation from the ground 119.25.

When using the 20L runway for takeoff, there is a high risk of taxiing errors due to the proximity of E1 and E2 runways, and the E taxiway's extension to the cargo apron. It is mandatory to exercise caution.

Runway 01 will use B12 for departure.

For departure on the 19th, the Selka1J is typically used. After takeoff, the air traffic controller may cancel the restricted direct flight to Selka and then direct a direct flight to SAV.

During a cruise in the Bangkok area, the aircraft recently experienced multiple failures including NAV ADS-B RPTG 1+2 FAULT and NAV BKUP SPD FAULT, followed by GPS PRIMARY LOST on both sides. It is recommended to be thoroughly familiar with the technical notice, maintain awareness of the minimum safe altitude throughout the flight, and follow the technical notice for handling.

Common procedures: RNAV entry

The minimum horizontal spacing of radar is 5nm, and it may be reduced to 3nm in BKKTMA, BKKCTR, and Suvarnabhumi ATZ.

Speed limits: Refer to the speed limits in Bangkok Terminal Area Chart 20-1P5. At 10,000 feet or below... maintain 250 knots unless ATC issues a 'No ATC speed restrictions' clearance. During intermediate approach, fly at 210 knots. In final approach, intercept or approach ILS course at 160-180 knots. When establishing ILS, maintain 160 knots.

The new Z approach procedure has been designated as the primary procedure in the air chart, with corresponding database updates. It is advised to carefully review the Warning section in the relevant approach chart to prevent unauthorized five-way turns into the approach procedure without ATC clearance.

When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention to the confirmation instructions to avoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. It is recommended to prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed to F/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

Our aircraft is typically parked at Satellite-1 Hall-1. At Suvarnabhumi Airport, a PDC is available. Once the PDC is confirmed, there's no need for repetition — simply contact ground control to request the push-up command. The ground frequency corresponding to the parking position can be found on the AMM chart.

ILS Z 01 BS690 mandatory 1600 RNP 02L BS670 mandatory 1600 ILS Z 19 BS790 mandatory 1600 RNP 20R BS770 mandatory 1600

During the deployment of some aircraft positions, the system may temporarily halt to issue an engine start command, after which it will resume aircraft traction. It is mandatory to carefully heed the instructions and avoid sudden braking, as this could risk shearing pin fracture.

Single-engine taxiing is not recommended when the taxi route is expected to include asphalt pavement.

In case of communication failure, follow the air chart or airport regulations.

The airspace is abnormally busy with short intervals, and the waiting time may differ from standard waiting periods. Please verify this.

Three runways will be operational: The original 01R/19L runway will be renamed 01/19, and the former 01L/19R runway will be renamed 02R/20L. The third runway, 02L/20R, will serve as a non-precision approach runway, allowing the use of the RNP approach procedure.

South approach and departure: 19 for takeoff and landing, 20L for takeoff, 20R for landing. North approach and departure: 01 for takeoff and landing, 02R for takeoff, 02L for landing.

If the skidway is uneven and the vehicle still cannot be moved out when the N1-50% threshold is reached, a tow truck is required.

The SVB station has been inactive for an extended period due to relocation, resulting in the absence of VOR approach procedures. The blind landing range finder exhibits positional inaccuracies relative to the runway end, which may cause operational instability.

Frequent military exercises often involve route changes. Please check against the flight plan.

During RNP approach procedures at this airport, ATC instructions may differ from the procedure design logic. Compliance with company FOIB.

Noise reduction procedure: See airport regulations

Pressure relief procedure: Refer to the release form

Radio Failure Procedure: Specific Implementation Methods in Airport Regulations and Jepperson Manual

The SVBVOR station will cease operations by 2025. Please note any program changes.

source_records.source_original_text_en: When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

source_records.source_original_text_en: During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

source_records.source_original_text_en: For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

source_records.text_en: When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

english_candidates.text: When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

部分机位推出过程中会临时停下给出启动发动机的指令，后续会继续牵引飞机，应该注意听清指令，不要盲目刹车，否则有导致剪切销断裂的风险

如预计经过沥青道面，不建议单发滑行

滑行道不平整如果 N1-50%时仍无法滑出，需要拖车

BANGKOKBLUEPORT(BANG-KOKBLUEPORT)，频率129.050，如果我们的机组人员在素万那普机场有任何疑问，例如需要TOBT/TSAT/停机位方面的信息，或者需要飞行计划方面的协助，或需要提出特殊要求，请通过此频率联系他们

地面运行时，应确保 Mode S 应答机可用，并且打开应答机（例如：非STAND-BY或 OFF位置），设置给定的Mode A 代码（离港飞机，来自于收到的放行许可；进港飞机，继续原代码直至完全在停机位停好）

H6与 H3,H5与 H2为同一条滑行道注意识别

在加油的时候，素万那普机场要求不要上客。如果必须在加油的时候上客，要先通知机场准备消防车。具体可询问春秋机务！

有减噪程序，除非影响飞行安全，在1900-2300UTC时间内不得使用大反推

为减少跑道占用时间，飞行员应确保在收到起飞许可后能立即开始起飞滑跑

离地自动脱波119.25

使用20L 跑道起飞时容易滑错，因为 E1，E2非常近，而且E 滑行道有延伸段去货机坪，请务必注意

01跑道会使用 B12离场

19 号起飞离场一般用Selka1J 离场，起飞后可能会指挥取消限制直飞Selka，然后可能指挥直飞 SAV

巡航时在曼谷区域，近期多触发 NAV ADS-B RPTG 1+2 FAULT,NAV BKUP SPD FAULT，随后出现两侧GPS PRIMARYLOST，应当提前熟知技术通告，飞行全过程中知晓最低安全高度，按技术通告处理

通讯失效后按航图或机场细则执行

空域异常繁忙，间隔较小，可能加入等待与标准等待或有出入注意证实

军演频繁，常涉及改航路，请对照飞行计划检查

减噪程序：见机场细则

释压程序：见放行单

无线电失效程序：机场细则及杰普逊手册有具体实施方法
departure.english_preview:
During ground operations, ensure the Mode S transponder is operational and activated (e.g., not in STAND-BY or OFF position). Set the designated Mode A code (for departing aircraft, use the code from the received clearance; for arriving aircraft, maintain the original code until fully parked in the apron).

To prevent potential interference, TCAS should remain activated for departing aircraft until receiving the go-to or go-around command, and deactivated for arriving aircraft until the aircraft has left the runway.

Note that H6 and H3, as well as H5 and H2, are on the same taxiway.

Suvarnabhumi Airport prohibits boarding during refueling. If boarding is necessary, notify the airport in advance to prepare fire trucks. For details, contact Spring Airlines Maintenance.

Noise reduction procedures are in effect. The use of heavy reverse thrust is prohibited between 1900 and 2300 UTC unless it compromises flight safety.

At Terminal S126 in Bangkok, the approach guidance system frequently exhibits abrupt switching: it may instantaneously shift from 2 meters to 0, then display "Stop"; after pressing "OK," the number may switch again, posing a risk of overshooting or failing to reach the correct position. Both flight crew and ground maintenance personnel have encountered this issue on multiple occasions.

Common procedures: RNAV

To minimize runway time, pilots must ensure they can begin taxiing immediately upon receiving the takeoff clearance.

Automatic wave separation from the ground 119.25.

When using the 20L runway for takeoff, there is a high risk of taxiing errors due to the proximity of E1 and E2 runways, and the E taxiway's extension to the cargo apron. It is mandatory to exercise caution.

Runway 01 will use B12 for departure.

For departure on the 19th, the Selka1J is typically used. After takeoff, the air traffic controller may cancel the restricted direct flight to Selka and then direct a direct flight to SAV.

During a cruise in the Bangkok area, the aircraft recently experienced multiple failures including NAV ADS-B RPTG 1+2 FAULT and NAV BKUP SPD FAULT, followed by GPS PRIMARY LOST on both sides. It is recommended to be thoroughly familiar with the technical notice, maintain awareness of the minimum safe altitude throughout the flight, and follow the technical notice for handling.

During the deployment of some aircraft positions, the system may temporarily halt to issue an engine start command, after which it will resume aircraft traction. It is mandatory to carefully heed the instructions and avoid sudden braking, as this could risk shearing pin fracture.

Single-engine taxiing is not recommended when the taxi route is expected to include asphalt pavement.

In case of communication failure, follow the air chart or airport regulations.

The airspace is abnormally busy with short intervals, and the waiting time may differ from standard waiting periods. Please verify this.

South approach and departure: 19 for takeoff and landing, 20L for takeoff, 20R for landing. North approach and departure: 01 for takeoff and landing, 02R for takeoff, 02L for landing.

If the skidway is uneven and the vehicle still cannot be moved out when the N1-50% threshold is reached, a tow truck is required.

Frequent military exercises often involve route changes. Please check against the flight plan.

Noise reduction procedure: See airport regulations

Pressure relief procedure: Refer to the release form

Radio Failure Procedure: Specific Implementation Methods in Airport Regulations and Jepperson Manual

The SVBVOR station will cease operations by 2025. Please note any program changes.

arrival.chinese_preview:
RNAV进场

雷达水平间隔最小5nm，在 BKKTMA、BKKCTR和素万那普 ATZ内，间隔可能减小到 3nm

航图新增Z 进近程序为主用程序，数据库也有变化，提示机组注意阅读对应进场图中Warning 中的说明，避免未经 ATC 许可转向五边加入进近程序

执行 VTBS 20R RNP 进近需要注意。ATKIN 之后转 5 边的航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165,intercept final course 20R,report established.”注意管制是要求先建立20R RNP 的五边，而不是许可 RNP 进近,注意证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以 RNP20R，容易造成能量大，注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP 进近不允许执行“高截获”程序

02L进近常指挥保持3 边航向，控制前后机距离，之后指挥直飞BATEM 或ABVER，在引入02LRNP 进近计划时MCDU会提示选择VIA BATEM 如果没有选择VIA 计划上看不到BATEM 点

02L落地后使用F W 跑道外等，使用W 穿越跑道Straight ahead D4 换频 121.95会直接给停机位和滑行路线例如 S123 D 滑行 G 前等，继续滑行 T18 或 T19 进位。机场细则中规定：02L/20R落地后不允许在快速脱离道停留去等待滑行指令，若无指令，02L 落地后应延 F、W、02R 外等，20R 落地后应延 F、Z、20L外等

我司常停在Satellite-1 卫星厅-1，素万那普有PDC，确认PDC 之后无需复诵，直接联系地面请求推开指令。停机位对应的地面频率可以在AMM 图上看到

ILS Z 01 BS690 mandatory 1600 RNP 02L BS670 mandatory 1600 ILS Z 19 BS790 mandatory 1600 RNP 20R BS770 mandatory 1600

三跑道运行，原01R/19L,跑道更名为 01/19跑道，原01L/19R 跑道更名为02R/20L 跑道。第三跑道02L/20R 将会作为非精密进近跑道使用，可以使用RNP 进近程序

南面进出港:19 用于起飞和落地，20L 用于起飞，20R 用于落地。北面进出港:01用于起飞和落地，02R 用于起飞，02L用于落地

曼谷进近只给出进场STAR 程序，不告知跑道，虽然通波只告知一条进近跑道，但仍有可能使用通波没有列出的跑道，机组建立五边之前务必证实跑道和进近方式

SVB 台因迁移长期不工作，已无 VOR 进近程序，盲降测距仪与跑道头位置有误差，避免不稳定

本机场实施 RNP 进近程序期间，ATC 指挥可能与程序设计逻辑存在差异，请以公司飞行操作通告为准

如预计经过沥青道面，不建议单发滑行

滑行道不平整如果 N1-50%时仍无法滑出，需要拖车

BANGKOKBLUEPORT(BANG-KOKBLUEPORT)，频率129.050，如果我们的机组人员在素万那普机场有任何疑问，例如需要TOBT/TSAT/停机位方面的信息，或者需要飞行计划方面的协助，或需要提出特殊要求，请通过此频率联系他们

为防止可能的干扰，对离港飞机，直到收到进入或者对正跑道指令才打开 TCAS；对于进港飞机，直到脱离跑道再关闭

H6与 H3,H5与 H2为同一条滑行道注意识别

在加油的时候，素万那普机场要求不要上客。如果必须在加油的时候上客，要先通知机场准备消防车。具体可询问春秋机务！

有减噪程序，除非影响飞行安全，在1900-2300UTC时间内不得使用大反推

曼谷的 s126机位的进位引导经常跳变，会出现瞬间从 2 米调到 0 然后出现 stop，ok 后又会跳变出数字，有滑过或者未滑行到位的风险，机组和机务都多次遇到此类情况

巡航时在曼谷区域，近期多触发 NAV ADS-B RPTG 1+2 FAULT,NAV BKUP SPD FAULT，随后出现两侧GPS PRIMARYLOST，应当提前熟知技术通告，飞行全过程中知晓最低安全高度，按技术通告处理

通讯失效后按航图或机场细则执行

空域异常繁忙，间隔较小，可能加入等待与标准等待或有出入注意证实

军演频繁，常涉及改航路，请对照飞行计划检查

减噪程序：见机场细则

释压程序：见放行单

无线电失效程序：机场细则及杰普逊手册有具体实施方法
arrival.english_preview:
On-site/Dispatch Frequency: BANGKOKBLUEPORT (BANG-KOKBLUEPORT), Frequency 129.050. Should our crew members have any inquiries at Suvarnabhumi Airport—such as requests for TOBT/TSAT/landing slot information, flight planning assistance, or special requests—please contact them via this frequency.

During ground operations, ensure the Mode S transponder is operational and activated (e.g., not in STAND-BY or OFF position). Set the designated Mode A code (for departing aircraft, use the code from the received clearance; for arriving aircraft, maintain the original code until fully parked in the apron).

To prevent potential interference, TCAS should remain activated for departing aircraft until receiving the go-to or go-around command, and deactivated for arriving aircraft until the aircraft has left the runway.

Note that H6 and H3, as well as H5 and H2, are on the same taxiway.

Suvarnabhumi Airport prohibits boarding during refueling. If boarding is necessary, notify the airport in advance to prepare fire trucks. For details, contact Spring Airlines Maintenance.

Noise reduction procedures are in effect. The use of heavy reverse thrust is prohibited between 1900 and 2300 UTC unless it compromises flight safety.

At Terminal S126 in Bangkok, the approach guidance system frequently exhibits abrupt switching: it may instantaneously shift from 2 meters to 0, then display "Stop"; after pressing "OK," the number may switch again, posing a risk of overshooting or failing to reach the correct position. Both flight crew and ground maintenance personnel have encountered this issue on multiple occasions.

During a cruise in the Bangkok area, the aircraft recently experienced multiple failures including NAV ADS-B RPTG 1+2 FAULT and NAV BKUP SPD FAULT, followed by GPS PRIMARY LOST on both sides. It is recommended to be thoroughly familiar with the technical notice, maintain awareness of the minimum safe altitude throughout the flight, and follow the technical notice for handling.

Common procedures: RNAV entry

The minimum horizontal spacing of radar is 5nm, and it may be reduced to 3nm in BKKTMA, BKKCTR, and Suvarnabhumi ATZ.

Speed limits: Refer to the speed limits in Bangkok Terminal Area Chart 20-1P5. At 10,000 feet or below... maintain 250 knots unless ATC issues a 'No ATC speed restrictions' clearance. During intermediate approach, fly at 210 knots. In final approach, intercept or approach ILS course at 160-180 knots. When establishing ILS, maintain 160 knots.

The new Z approach procedure has been designated as the primary procedure in the air chart, with corresponding database updates. It is advised to carefully review the Warning section in the relevant approach chart to prevent unauthorized five-way turns into the approach procedure without ATC clearance.

When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention to the confirmation instructions to avoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. It is recommended to prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed to F/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

Our aircraft is typically parked at Satellite-1 Hall-1. At Suvarnabhumi Airport, a PDC is available. Once the PDC is confirmed, there's no need for repetition — simply contact ground control to request the push-up command. The ground frequency corresponding to the parking position can be found on the AMM chart.

ILS Z 01 BS690 mandatory 1600 RNP 02L BS670 mandatory 1600 ILS Z 19 BS790 mandatory 1600 RNP 20R BS770 mandatory 1600

During the deployment of some aircraft positions, the system may temporarily halt to issue an engine start command, after which it will resume aircraft traction. It is mandatory to carefully heed the instructions and avoid sudden braking, as this could risk shearing pin fracture.

Single-engine taxiing is not recommended when the taxi route is expected to include asphalt pavement.

In case of communication failure, follow the air chart or airport regulations.

The airspace is abnormally busy with short intervals, and the waiting time may differ from standard waiting periods. Please verify this.

Three runways will be operational: The original 01R/19L runway will be renamed 01/19, and the former 01L/19R runway will be renamed 02R/20L. The third runway, 02L/20R, will serve as a non-precision approach runway, allowing the use of the RNP approach procedure.

South approach and departure: 19 for takeoff and landing, 20L for takeoff, 20R for landing. North approach and departure: 01 for takeoff and landing, 02R for takeoff, 02L for landing.

If the skidway is uneven and the vehicle still cannot be moved out when the N1-50% threshold is reached, a tow truck is required.

The SVB station has been inactive for an extended period due to relocation, resulting in the absence of VOR approach procedures. The blind landing range finder exhibits positional inaccuracies relative to the runway end, which may cause operational instability.

Frequent military exercises often involve route changes. Please check against the flight plan.

During RNP approach procedures at this airport, ATC instructions may differ from the procedure design logic. Compliance with company FOIB.

Noise reduction procedure: See airport regulations

Pressure relief procedure: Refer to the release form

Radio Failure Procedure: Specific Implementation Methods in Airport Regulations and Jepperson Manual

The SVBVOR station will cease operations by 2025. Please note any program changes.

When entering stands with manual marshalling, stop taxi if ground marshalling personnel are not on-site (frequently encountered after ad-hoc stand change post-landing). Notify ATC promptly, keep engines running and await further instructions.

上海浦东.chinese_core_preview:
机坪有时给推出开车指令，有时候给推出到位报告指令，机组注意识别并 遵守指令。

地面运行换频频繁，换频指令与滑行等待位置较近，机组注意，防止滑错/滑过线。

离场方式在滑行时也可能发生变更，在变更离场方式后，及时遵循 SOP 离 场变更执行更改计划，并做好补充简令，执行离场变更检查单，避免飞错。

浦东机场离地后自动脱波，脱波频率按照 PDC 或放行许可。

从BK 进场，若向北运行时，通常用西跑道 35L 号，若向南运行时，通常东 跑道 16L。

进场程序较多，有时会临时更改，在非繁忙时刻通常会有直飞，机组做好预 案。

浦东向南进近过程中曾多次触发 TA/RA 告警，请机组进近准备时做好相关 预案，按照手册记忆项目程序执行。

浦东 17R/35L 跑道，ATC 可能指挥短切五边或较晚发布盲降许可，机组做好 预判并提前做好能量管理，积极沟通，按需接受 ATC 雷达引导的指令。当 需要实施"从上方截获下滑道"程序时，严格遵循 SOP 要求，如无法满足稳 定进近标准，果断复飞或中止进近。

近期发生多次浦东机场 168 号停机位，因上坡和单发原因油门加至地面最 大可用推力仍不能移动飞机，而关车申请拖车。请注意在此类停机位的进 位速度。

浦东机场细则要求，AD2.20，3.2.4"进港航空器机组发现地面滑行引导车 后关闭滑行灯，跟随地面滑行引导车滑行"。

机组在进入设置目视泊位引导系统的机位时，发现有疑问的引导指示，或 进入由人工引导入位的机位时发现地面接机人员未就位（尤其是着陆后临 时更换机位时常发生），应当立即停止滑行，及时通报 ATC，并应当保持发 动机运转，等待后续处置。

跑道信息：16L/34R（3800m×60m）；16R/34L（3800m×60m）；17L/35R（4000m× 60m）；17R/35L（3400m×60m）。

PAPI信息：16L：跑道左侧入口内 454 米，3°，MEHT 20.9m；34R：跑道左 侧入口内 455 米，3°，MEHT 21.5m；16R：跑道左侧入口内 452 米，3°，MEHT 21.9m；34L：跑道左侧入口内 452 米，3°，MEHT 22.4m；17L：跑 道左侧入口内 464 米，3°，MEHT 21.7m；35R：跑道左侧入口内 464 米，3°，MEHT 22.5m；17R：跑道左侧入口内 452 米，3°，MEHT 21.4m；35L：跑道左侧入口内 452 米，3°，MEHT 21.0m。

上海浦东.english_core_preview:
Apron control may issue push-back and start-up clearance, or instruction to report push-back complete. It is required to identify and comply with relevant clearances.

Closure of Taxiway E and Taxiway T1 is NOT published in NOTAMs. Refer to construction area chart (2C-1-SUP).

Frequent frequency changes occur during surface movement. Frequency change points are geographically close to taxi holding positions. Exercise vigilance to prevent taxi routing errors or overshooting holding lines.

Departure procedure may be amended while taxiing. Upon departure-mode revision, execute SOP for departure change, update flight plan, conduct supplementary briefing and apply departure-change checklist to avoid track deviation.

Automatic frequency hand-off upon lift-off at Pudong. Handoff frequency shall be in accordance with PDC or ATC departure clearance.

For BK arrival: during north-bound operations, RWY 35L (western runway) is normally assigned; during south-bound operations, RWY 16L (eastern runway) is normally assigned.

Multiple arrival procedures are in use, with ad-hoc amendments possible. Direct-to clearances are common during off-peak periods. Maintain contingency plans.

Multiple TA/RA alerts have been recorded during south-bound approaches into Pudong. Prepare contingency measures during approach preparation and execute memory-item procedures per aircraft manual.

For RWY 17R / 35L, ATC may assign short base-leg vectors or issue ILS clearance at a late stage. Anticipate such scenarios, conduct proactive energy management, maintain active communication and accept ATC radar vectors as required. When performing “glideslope capture from above” procedure, strictly comply with SOP. If stable-approach criteria cannot be satisfied, execute missed approach or discontinued approach without hesitation.

For RWY 34R approach, tall obstacles exist slightly right-of-track between waypoints PD083 and PD084. Over-flying at or maintaining 600 m may trigger GPWS caution alerts. Follow the operational advisory “Reminder on GPWS Caution Triggers for RWY 34R Approaches at Pudong” available in EFB.

Several recent incidents occurred at Stand 168: due to uphill gradient and single-engine taxi condition, aircraft could not move even with maximum available ground thrust, requiring engine shutdown and tow-in service. Control taxi speed when docking at stands with such gradients.

Per Pudong Aerodrome Instructions AD2.20, 3.2.4: “Upon sighting marshalling vehicle, arriving crews shall switch off taxi lights and follow the marshalling vehicle”.

When taxiing towards stands equipped with Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS): stop taxi immediately if receiving ambiguous guidance indications. When entering stands with manual marshalling, stop taxi if ground marshalling personnel are not on-site (frequently encountered after ad-hoc stand change post-landing). Notify ATC promptly, keep engines running and await further instructions.

Runway Information: 16L/34R (3800 m × 60 m); 16R/34L (3800 m × 60 m); 17L/35R (4000 m × 60 m); 17R/35L (3400 m × 60 m)

source_records.source_original_text_en: When taxiing towards stands equipped with Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS): stop taxi immediately if receiving ambiguous guidance indications. When entering stands with manual marshalling, stop taxi if ground marshalling personnel are not on-site (frequently encountered after ad-hoc stand change post-landing). Notify ATC promptly, keep engines running and await further instructions.

arrival.english_preview:
Closure of Taxiway E and Taxiway T1 is NOT published in NOTAMs. Refer to construction area chart (2C-1-SUP).

Frequent frequency changes occur during surface movement. Frequency change points are geographically close to taxi holding positions. Exercise vigilance to prevent taxi routing errors or overshooting holding lines.

For BK arrival: during north-bound operations, RWY 35L (western runway) is normally assigned; during south-bound operations, RWY 16L (eastern runway) is normally assigned.

Multiple arrival procedures are in use, with ad-hoc amendments possible. Direct-to clearances are common during off-peak periods. Maintain contingency plans.

Multiple TA/RA alerts have been recorded during south-bound approaches into Pudong. Prepare contingency measures during approach preparation and execute memory-item procedures per aircraft manual.

For RWY 17R / 35L, ATC may assign short base-leg vectors or issue ILS clearance at a late stage. Anticipate such scenarios, conduct proactive energy management, maintain active communication and accept ATC radar vectors as required. When performing “glideslope capture from above” procedure, strictly comply with SOP. If stable-approach criteria cannot be satisfied, execute missed approach or discontinued approach without hesitation.

For RWY 34R approach, tall obstacles exist slightly right-of-track between waypoints PD083 and PD084. Over-flying at or maintaining 600 m may trigger GPWS caution alerts. Follow the operational advisory “Reminder on GPWS Caution Triggers for RWY 34R Approaches at Pudong” available in EFB.

Several recent incidents occurred at Stand 168: due to uphill gradient and single-engine taxi condition, aircraft could not move even with maximum available ground thrust, requiring engine shutdown and tow-in service. Control taxi speed when docking at stands with such gradients.

Per Pudong Aerodrome Instructions AD2.20, 3.2.4: “Upon sighting marshalling vehicle, arriving crews shall switch off taxi lights and follow the marshalling vehicle”.

When taxiing towards stands equipped with Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS): stop taxi immediately if receiving ambiguous guidance indications. When entering stands with manual marshalling, stop taxi if ground marshalling personnel are not on-site (frequently encountered after ad-hoc stand change post-landing). Notify ATC promptly, keep engines running and await further instructions.

Runway Information: 16L/34R (3800 m × 60 m); 16R/34L (3800 m × 60 m); 17L/35R (4000 m × 60 m); 17R/35L (3400 m × 60 m)

core.text_en: For Nanjing's Runway 25 ILS approach: The OF-54F aircraft isentering the approach path. The crew isadvised to initiate deceleration and altitude reduction in advance.

.南京滑行道B/T7/T8滑行道为同条滑行道，B和T7分 界线为A7滑行道，T7和T8滑行道分界线为T12，其地面标 志较为模糊，有滑错风险。

机场标高：14.9M/49FT。

现场/签派频率：现场131.65，PDC可用，ACARS可用(试 运行)D-ATIS可用。

航空器进出停机坪的道口根据起降方向相对 固定。具体滑行路线听管制指挥。

原则上落地飞机使用快速脱离道退出跑道。

07号跑道落地，如果使用D5快速脱离道，后 续会指挥D5-P滑行，P滑行道在D5左手边，注意不 要转错上Q。

南京机场特点115停机位滑行道上坡明显，单 发滑行进位时需注意。

公司机位多停在T1航站楼，07/25落地后D-P-Q3-Q跟引导进位。

无需复诵PDC。

故请在离开飞机前先 通知本场机务到飞机上确认交接事项。交接主要内容有 ①机组或驻场代办需确认货舱内无活物，临时取消航班 上以配餐食已处置再要求机务人员断电，本场机务不对 活物死亡或食物变质负责；②关舱门前双方核实机供品情况。

.未经ATC许可，航空器不得飞越控制线（B点-C点-D点-E 点连线）以南，详见南京进离场图。

常用程序：常用程序：飞兰州方向，06跑道起飞使用 HFE61X离场，可能指挥左转飞向NJ212然后MAGLI加入航 路，24号跑道使用HFE42X，管制可能指挥飞TUTKI加入 V78航路到FYG。

注意事项：PBN离场程序为主，注意对照航图和放行指 令检查离场航路。

07号：通常使用OF-71F。

25号：通常使用OF-52F或者OF-54F,注意和ATC证 实。

双跑道运行，07/25主落,06/24主要用于起飞，沈 宁沈经由OF进离场。

07号跑道盲降进近，管制指令下高度偏晚，注意 稳定时机。

进场航图复杂，程序易混淆，例如，OF-52F进 场如果经由点选择MLJ，就会实际飞成OF-54F进场，请机组注意，严格比对航图，避免飞错程序。

南京24/25号KAKIS进场可能会指挥直飞GOSRO（G OSRO在06/07进场程序中），后直飞NJ219加入程序。

南京25号跑道ILS进近，OF-54F进场，过OF后 NJ214附近，飞机不多时可能会指挥直飞IAF NJ209点，此时下降剖面较为紧张，可能在切入五边时高度仍然偏 高，请机组注意提前减速和下降高度。

机场通播中有时对复飞高度有要求，机组进近时 注意检查。

南京25号跑道ILS进场HEF52F，进近指挥在快到 NJ206前左转飞四边并且容易有顺风，指挥下高度600米 后左转飞向五边，但是由于顺风原因剖面比较紧张，容 易高截获。

06号落地有一个直角脱离道A4，如果落地后前机 A5脱离，未穿越A4时，管制不会让用A4脱离，建议机组 保持观察，避免过早减速而无法正常脱离导致与后机间 距过小。

使用07号落地时常用P向北滑行，塔台常给指令 脱离跑道报。若使用第二条快速脱离道D5脱离，完全脱 离跑道时飞机已经到达P道口，非常容易错过。建议机组 提前观察好滑行道口注意减速。

进近指挥空域受控，易造成剖面紧张。

Most company aircraft are parked in Terminal 1. After landing on July 25, the D-P-Q3-Q aircraft followed the taxi-in guidance.

No need to repeat PDC.

Therefore, please ensure to notify the airport maintenance team to confirm handover details on board before disembarking. The main handover items include: ① The crew or on-site agent must confirm the cargo hold is free of live animals. If a flight istemporarily canceled and the onboard meals have been disposed of, requesting the crew to cut power isacceptable. The airport maintenance spoilage. ②Both parties verify the status of the aircraft supplies before the gate closure.

After the Jieyang-Nanjing and Shanghai regional EMRID, proceed to OLRIS, with special attention to route point verification.

Model 07: Typically uses the OF-71F.

On the 25th: Typically use OF-52F or OF-54F, and confirm with ATC.

The airport operates with dual runways, primarily serving takeoffs on July 25 and landings on June 24, while Shenyang-Ningde and Shenyang-Jingdezhen flights use OF (Off-Field) for approach and departure.

During the blind landing approach to Runway 07, the air traffic control issued the altitude instruction late. Ensure proper timing for stabilization.

The approach chart iscomplex and the procedure can be confusing. For example, if the OF-52F approach is selected via point MLJ, it will actually execute as an OF- 54F approach. Crew must strictly compare the chart to avoid procedural errors.

On 24/25, the Nanjing KAKIS may direct a direct flight to GOSRO (as specified in the 06/07 arrival procedure), followed by a direct flight to NJ219 to join the arrival procedure.

For Nanjing's Runway 25 ILS approach: The OF-54F aircraft isentering the approach path. After passing OF and approaching NJ214, when the aircraft density decreases, the controller may direct a straight flight to IAF NJ209. During this phase, the descent profile becomes critical, and the aircraft may still maintain excessive altitude upon entering the five-point approach. The crew isadvised to initiate deceleration and altitude reduction in advance.

During airport broadcasts, there may be requirements for the go-around altitude. It is recommended to carefully check these specifications during approach.

The controlled airspace for approach commands can easily lead to profile tension.

source_records.text_en: Regarding the 9C7194 flight from Dalian Zhoushuizi to Nanjing Lukou on May 17,2024: During approach, the aircraft exhibited excessive energy. The control team initiated a 07 ILS (Instrument Landing System) during the fourth turn. Although crosswind affected the cockpit, the crew failed to reduce energy promptly, resulting in premature fifth turn and excessive inner crossing above the downwind path. The crew then executed a full high-intercept procedure with wheel release. The aircraft remained unstable at 1,000 feet and was forced to return at 800 feet before landing on runway 25.

arrival.english_preview:
The approach and departure gates for aircraft entering and exiting the apron are fixed according to the takeoff and landing directions. The specific taxiing route shall be subject to air traffic control instructions.

When landing on Runway 07, if the D5 quick departure channel is used, the system will direct the aircraft to taxi to the D5-P channel. The P taxiway is located to the left of D5. Be careful not to mistakenly turn onto the Q channel.

Nanjing Airport Characteristics: The 115th apron features a steep uphill taxiway, requiring special attention during single-engine taxiing.

Most company aircraft are parked in Terminal 1. After landing on July 25, the D-P-Q3-Q aircraft followed the taxi-in guidance.

Quality Control Department, Nanjing Lukou Airport Maintenance Division Notice: Due to some flight crews recently experiencing extended layover periods, they may rest athotels without notifying the airport maintenance staff, which could lead to potential oversights in subsequent support procedures. Therefore, please ensure to notify the airport maintenance team to confirm handover details on board before disembarking. The main handover items include: ① The crew or on-site agent must confirm the cargo hold is free of live animals. If a flight istemporarily canceled and the onboard meals have been disposed of, requesting the crew to cut power isacceptable. The airport maintenance spoilage. ②Both parties verify the status of the aircraft supplies before the gate closure.

After the Lanzhou-Nanjing route is rerouted to Zhengzhou, passengers on flight P403 can request a direct connection to P450 or FYG.

From Xiamen (Shenzhen) to Nanjing, after the Shanghai regional command EMRID, proceed to OLRIS, and ensure route points are checked.

After the Jieyang-Nanjing and Shanghai regional EMRID, proceed to OLRIS, with special attention to route point verification.

Model 07: Typically uses the OF-71F.

On the 25th: Typically use OF-52F or OF-54F, and confirm with ATC.

The airport operates with dual runways, primarily serving takeoffs on July 25 and landings on June 24, while Shenyang-Ningde and Shenyang-Jingdezhen flights use OF (Off-Field) for approach and departure.

During the blind landing approach to Runway 07, the air traffic control issued the altitude instruction late. Ensure proper timing for stabilization.

The approach chart iscomplex and the procedure can be confusing. For example, if the OF-52F approach is selected via point MLJ, it will actually execute as an OF- 54F approach. Crew must strictly compare the chart to avoid procedural errors.

On 24/25, the Nanjing KAKIS may direct a direct flight to GOSRO (as specified in the 06/07 arrival procedure), followed by a direct flight to NJ219 to join the arrival procedure.

For Nanjing's Runway 25 ILS approach: The OF-54F aircraft isentering the approach path. After passing OF and approaching NJ214, when the aircraft density decreases, the controller may direct a straight flight to IAF NJ209. During this phase, the descent profile becomes critical, and the aircraft may still maintain excessive altitude upon entering the five-point approach. The crew isadvised to initiate deceleration and altitude reduction in advance.

During airport broadcasts, there may be requirements for the go-around altitude. It is recommended to carefully check these specifications during approach.

The controlled airspace for approach commands can easily lead to profile tension.

(1). Military airfields and artillery firing zones exist north of Nanjing Airport. Strictly follow instructions to avoid flight conflicts and restricted detours.

. Aircraft must not fly south of the control line (the line connecting points B, C, D, and E) without ATC clearance. Refer to the Nanjing arrival/departure chart for details.

. The B/T7/T8 taxiway in Nanjing isa single taxiway. The boundary between B and T7 is designated as A7 taxiway, while the separation line between T7 and T8 is marked as T12. The ground markings are somewhat indistinct, posing a risk of taxiway misidentification.

Noise Reduction Procedure: Noise Reduction Exit Procedure 1 (NADP1)

Pressure reliefprocedure: Nanjing-Lanzhou details are provided in EFB

Radio failure procedure: See airport regulations for details

Operation restrictions: None.

Airport elevation: 14.9 meters (49 feet)

core.text_zh: 05号进近时，在五边应保持好航迹，不得偏东，严格 掌握好过外指点标（D4.5XMN）和切（XLN）导航台的时机与 高度。当飞机较少，塔台指挥自主建立时，严格按照进近图 公布高度下降。西侧进港的飞机，及早注意减速申请下降高 度。
core.text_en: During the 05 approach, maintain the correct course at the five-point approach point without eastward deviation, and strictlycontrol the timing and altitude for passing the outer reference beacon (D4.5XMN) and the XLN (Crossing Point) navigation station. When the airfield islightly trafficked and the tower isoperating autonomously, strictly follow the descent altitude specified in the approach chart. Aircraft entering from the west should promptly slow down and request altitude reduction.

core.text_zh: 23号进近时，四转弯不要早，五边侧方有山，避免产 生地形警告。各别进场程序由于地形原因，下降较晚，注意 剖面控制。
core.text_en: During approach 23, avoid premature four-turn maneuvers. The five sides are flanked by mountains to prevent terrain warnings. Due to topographical constraints, individual entry procedures may require delayed descent; maintain profile control.

english_core.text_en: If Runway 05 ILS fails,the crew may initiate RNP 05 approach. Note that the arrival gate number differs. Additionally, when RNP approaches Runway 05 and the AP is disconnected at the minimum descent altitude, the profile tends to be elevated. Control measures: ①Prepare contingency plans in the briefing, and execute a decisive go-around ifan unstable approach occurs; Ifthe drop rate exceeds 1000 feet, the PM must issue a warning. ②During operation, ifthe altitude profile ishigher than expected after visual check, stabilize the descent point, then check the descent rate. If the rate is within 1000 feet per minute, continue the approach; otherwise, return tothe runway. ③ Xiamen now requires that both the covered bridge and passenger elevators must be removed and fully prepared before reporting. On the Xiamen-Nanyang route, the flight sequence may be directed as follows: QO, then P48, followed by P263, JDZ, and finally XSH.

厦门高崎.chinese_core_preview:
厦门机场根据桥载协议规定若拒绝使用桥载设备将会 对公司收取违约金，请机组务必配合。

05号跑道等待点在跑道侧方，注意加强地面观察，避 免划过线，造成跑道侵入。

碰到特殊情况，严禁向海岸方向绕飞，并必须严格听 从地面指挥，防止误入大小金门等岛屿上空。23号跑道有时 使用ATC指定离场，务必遵守速度限制，航图中要求禁止偏 东，否则会遭到投诉。

常用程序：RNAV离港程序。

距离台湾金门区域较近，若指挥向东偏航，注意距离。

05号RNAV离场，上海方向通常使用DOVPU-9Z，有爬升 梯度要求，要求大于等于5%的爬升梯度至AM304，单发时要 注意爬升性能。

在航空器起飞性能允许的情况下，尽可能使用减推力 起飞。

航空器爬升到1500ft（QNH）调整和保持发动机爬升功 率/推力，保持爬升速度V2+15kt，保持襟翼和缝翼在起飞状 态。

航空器起飞爬升到3000ft（QNH）转为正常爬升速度，并按照程序收襟翼/缝翼。

常用程序：RNAV进港程序。

RWY05如果从福清FQG方向进场，通常会指挥直飞杏林。

05号进近时，在五边应保持好航迹，不得偏东，严格 掌握好过外指点标（D4.5XMN）和切（XLN）导航台的时机与 高度。当飞机较少，塔台指挥自主建立时，严格按照进近图 公布高度下降。西侧进港的飞机，及早注意减速申请下降高 度。

23号进近时，四转弯不要早，五边侧方有山，避免产 生地形警告。各别进场程序由于地形原因，下降较晚，注意 剖面控制。

注意跑道入口内移，易产生错觉。

05/23号复飞程序有时会写保持一边上900米，建议综 合参考通播和管制要求。

地形：机场地势较高，地形复杂，东北端临海，地势较低，西南端临厦门港，人工建筑物较多、较高，对起降飞行有 一定影响。

M503航路视情况实施偏置。

进离港需要严格遵守高度、速度、转弯半径限制。

雷雨绕飞时空域受限。

：地势跑道05高，跑道23低。

（1）机场东北侧为金门岛，距离本场较近需 严格按照航图的限制飞行。厦门机场附近GPS信号被干扰事件较 多，其他航司多次出现因GPS信号干扰导致的GPWS警告。

释压程序：厦门=兰州涉及释压航路。

低温修正：按照公司相关规定执行。
厦门高崎.english_core_preview:
Under the bridge loading agreement, Xiamen Airport will impose a penalty fee on the company for refusing to use the bridge loading equipment. The crew is required to comply with this requirement.

After landing and separating from aircraft 05, it may sometimes direct aircraft B9, B, or B7 ahead. Note that B7 has no waiting line; it is recommended to maintain a safe distance, as nighttime risks are higher. Alternatively, aircraft 05 may land and wait ahead of aircraft A and B10. B10 has no waiting line and isrelatively close to B11; it is recommended to remain vigilant.

Common Procedures: RNAV Departure Procedures

Automatic wavelet separation after takeoff 121.35 (frequency shown on PDC).

Xiamen to Langman, departure at 05:00 NUSPA. Due to the restricted area south of the airport requiring strict control of turning radius, the AM124 procedure sets a speed limit of 200 knots. Maintain configuration 1 during turns. Given the aircraft's weight, be mindful of overspeed risks and the 20,000-foot configuration limit. The speed limit may be lifted after turning.

Given its proximity to Taiwan's Kinmen area, maintain close monitoring of the distance when directing eastward course changes.

The 05 RNAV departs, while the Shanghai-bound flight typically uses the DOVPU-9Z. A climb gradient of ≥5% is required to AM304, and special attention must be paid to climb performance during single-engine operation.

Adjust the M503 route deviation as needed

During idle periods on the Xiamen-Nanyang route, passengers near P326/P306 in Xiamen can request a direct flight to P47. After connecting at P47 to Nanchang, they may apply for a flight to TULMU. When approaching Wuhan, a 6,600-meter descent will be required. After connecting at TULMU to Wuhan XSH, passengers can request a flight to HOK.

For the Xiamen-Changchun route, passengers may request a flight from Dongshan DST to Zhoushan HSN during the outbound leg.

For the Xiamen-Lanzhou route (P36), if the altitude cannot be raised above 7,800 meters before reaching HOK, the Wuhan area will be inaccessible. It is mandatory to maintain low altitude until HOK. Subsequent altitude adjustments will depend on Zhengzhou's instructions. It is mandatory to closely monitor fuel levels.

After the Xiamen-Nanjing and Shanghai regional EMRID, proceed to OLRIS, and ensure route points are checked.

Flights from Xiamen to Shenyang can be scheduled via DST for a 4-minute (approximately 30nm) saving when flying to HSN. After PONAB, direct flights to PINOT are available. Flights to NIXEP can be arranged after VED. Additionally, flights to QO can be requested after FD.

Common Procedures: RNAV Port Entry Procedures

RWY05: When entering from Fuqing FQG, pilots are typically directed to fly directly to Xinglin XLN.

During the 05 approach, maintain the correct course at the five-point approach point without eastward deviation, and strictlycontrol the timing and altitude for passing the outer reference beacon (D4.5XMN) and the XLN (Crossing Point) navigation station. When the airfield islightly trafficked and the tower isoperating autonomously, strictly follow the descent altitude specified in the approach chart. Aircraft entering from the west should promptly slow down and request altitude reduction.

During approach 23, avoid premature four-turn maneuvers. The five sides are flanked by mountains to prevent terrain warnings. Due to topographical constraints, individual entry procedures may require delayed descent; maintain profile control.

The inward shift of the runway entrance may cause visual illusions.

If Runway 05 ILS fails, the crew may initiate RNP 05 approach. Note that the arrival gate number differs. Additionally, when RNP approaches Runway 05 and the AP is disconnected at the minimum descent altitude, the profile tends to be elevated. Control measures: ①Prepare contingency plans in the briefing, and execute a decisive go-around ifan unstable approach occurs; If the drop rate exceeds 1000 feet, the PM must issue a warning. ②During operation, if the altitude profile ishigher than expected after visual check, stabilize the descent point, then check the descent rate. If the rate is within 1000 feet per minute, continue the approach; otherwise, return to the runway. ③ Xiamen now requires that both the covered bridge and passenger elevators must be removed and fully prepared before reporting. On the Xiamen-Nanyang route, the flight sequence may be directed as follows: QO, then P48, followed by P263, JDZ, and finally XSH.

Strict compliance with altitude, speed, and turning radius restrictions is required for port entry and departure.

Thunderstorm is restricted in space-time domain.

Track surface characteristics: The terrain ishigher at Runway 05 and lower at Runway 23.

Terrain: The airport is situated at a higher elevation with complex topography. Itsnortheastern end borders the sea at a lower elevation, while the southwestern end adjoins Xiamen Port. Numerous tall artificialstructures in the area significantly impact takeoff and landing operations.

(1) The northeast side of the airport borders Kinmen Island, which is relatively close to this airport and requires strict adherence to flight restrictions specified in the airworthiness chart. There have been frequent GPS signal interference incidents near Xiamen Airport, with other airlines repeatedly issuing GPWS warnings due to GPS signal interference.

In exceptional circumstances, any deviation towards the coast isstrictly prohibited. Pilots must strictly follow ground instructions to avoid entering airspace over islands such as the Greater and Lesser Kinmen Islands. For Runway 23, ATC may designate departure points. Strict adherence to speed limits is mandatory, and the flight plan explicitly prohibits eastward deviations, with non-compliance subject to penalties.

The 05/23 reflight procedure may instruct to maintain an altitude of 900 meters. It isrecommended to consult both the air traffic control (ATC) and air traffic control (ATC) requirements for comprehensive guidance.

When the aircraft'stake-off performance permits, use reduced-thrust takeoff whenever possible.

The aircraft ascends to 1500ft (QNH), adjusting and maintaining engine climb power/thrust at V2+15kt, with flaps and slats kept in takeoff position.

The aircraft transitions to normal climb speed after reaching 3000ft (QNH) during takeoff, then retracts the flaps/sweeps according to the procedure.

Pressure relief procedure: The route between Xiamen and Lanzhou involves pressure reliefoperations.

Radio Failure Procedure: Refer to the Instrument Flight Rules for Aircraft Two-Way Radio Communication Failure Procedure in NAIP General Provisions 3.4.5.

Low-temperature correction: In accordance with the company's relevant regulations

Visual approach: The 05 short five-sided visual approach is prohibited (due to terrain turning conditions, simulator verification failed) Japan and South Korea

source_records.source_original_text_en: If Runway 05 ILS fails,the crew may initiate RNP 05 approach. Note that the arrival gate number differs. Additionally, when RNP approaches Runway 05 and the AP is disconnected at the minimum descent altitude, the profile tends to be elevated. Control measures: ①Prepare contingency plans in the briefing, and execute a decisive go-around ifan unstable approach occurs; Ifthe drop rate exceeds 1000 feet, the PM must issue a warning. ②During operation, ifthe altitude profile ishigher than expected after visual check, stabilize the descent point, then check the descent rate. If the rate is within 1000 feet per minute, continue the approach; otherwise, return tothe runway. ③ Xiamen now requires that both the covered bridge and passenger elevators must be removed and fully prepared before reporting. On the Xiamen-Nanyang route, the flight sequence may be directed as follows: QO, then P48, followed by P263, JDZ, and finally XSH.

source_records.text_zh: 进场：如05号ILS不工作，机组可以申请试用RNP05号进近，注意进港号不同，另外，RNP进近05号跑道，在最低下降高 断开AP时，往往剖面偏高，控制措施：①简令中做好预案，如果出现不稳定进近，果断复飞；如果下降率超过1000英尺，PM需要作出提醒。②运行中，若在转目视以后，高度剖面偏高，稳定下滑点后，检查下降率，下降率在1000英尺每分钟含以内，继续进近，否则复飞。③厦门现要求廊桥和客梯车都撤走之后，完全准备好才报告。厦门到南阳段有时会指挥QO之后飞P48然后P263之后飞JDZ然后XSH。
source_records.text_en: If Runway 05 ILS fails,the crew may initiate RNP 05 approach. Note that the arrival gate number differs. Additionally, when RNP approaches Runway 05 and the AP is disconnected at the minimum descent altitude, the profile tends to be elevated. Control measures: ①Prepare contingency plans in the briefing, and execute a decisive go-around ifan unstable approach occurs; Ifthe drop rate exceeds 1000 feet, the PM must issue a warning. ②During operation, ifthe altitude profile ishigher than expected after visual check, stabilize the descent point, then check the descent rate. If the rate is within 1000 feet per minute, continue the approach; otherwise, return tothe runway. ③ Xiamen now requires that both the covered bridge and passenger elevators must be removed and fully prepared before reporting. On the Xiamen-Nanyang route, the flight sequence may be directed as follows: QO, then P48, followed by P263, JDZ, and finally XSH.

departure.english_preview:
Under the bridge loading agreement, Xiamen Airport will impose a penalty fee on the company for refusing to use the bridge loading equipment. The crew is required to comply with this requirement.

Common Procedures: RNAV Departure Procedures

Automatic wavelet separation after takeoff 121.35 (frequency shown on PDC).

Xiamen to Langman, departure at 05:00 NUSPA. Due to the restricted area south of the airport requiring strict control of turning radius, the AM124 procedure sets a speed limit of 200 knots. Maintain configuration 1 during turns. Given the aircraft's weight, be mindful of overspeed risks and the 20,000-foot configuration limit. The speed limit may be lifted after turning.

Given its proximity to Taiwan's Kinmen area, maintain close monitoring of the distance when directing eastward course changes.

The 05 RNAV departs, while the Shanghai-bound flight typically uses the DOVPU-9Z. A climb gradient of ≥5% is required to AM304, and special attention must be paid to climb performance during single-engine operation.

Adjust the M503 route deviation as needed

During idle periods on the Xiamen-Nanyang route, passengers near P326/P306 in Xiamen can request a direct flight to P47. After connecting at P47 to Nanchang, they may apply for a flight to TULMU. When approaching Wuhan, a 6,600-meter descent will be required. After connecting at TULMU to Wuhan XSH, passengers can request a flight to HOK.

For the Xiamen-Changchun route, passengers may request a flight from Dongshan DST to Zhoushan HSN during the outbound leg.

For the Xiamen-Lanzhou route (P36), if the altitude cannot be raised above 7,800 meters before reaching HOK, the Wuhan area will be inaccessible. It is mandatory to maintain low altitude until HOK. Subsequent altitude adjustments will depend on Zhengzhou's instructions. It is mandatory to closely monitor fuel levels.

After the Xiamen-Nanjing and Shanghai regional EMRID, proceed to OLRIS, and ensure route points are checked.

Flights from Xiamen to Shenyang can be scheduled via DST for a 4-minute (approximately 30nm) saving when flying to HSN. After PONAB, direct flights to PINOT are available. Flights to NIXEP can be arranged after VED. Additionally, flights to QO can be requested after FD.

Strict compliance with altitude, speed, and turning radius restrictions is required for port entry and departure.

Thunderstorm is restricted in space-time domain.

Track surface characteristics: The terrain ishigher at Runway 05 and lower at Runway 23.

Terrain: The airport is situated at a higher elevation with complex topography. Itsnortheastern end borders the sea at a lower elevation, while the southwestern end adjoins Xiamen Port. Numerous tall artificialstructures in the area significantly impact takeoff and landing operations.

(1) The northeast side of the airport borders Kinmen Island, which is relatively close to this airport and requires strict adherence to flight restrictions specified in the airworthiness chart. There have been frequent GPS signal interference incidents near Xiamen Airport, with other airlines repeatedly issuing GPWS warnings due to GPS signal interference.

In exceptional circumstances, any deviation towards the coast isstrictly prohibited. Pilots must strictly follow ground instructions to avoid entering airspace over islands such as the Greater and Lesser Kinmen Islands. For Runway 23, ATC may designate departure points. Strict adherence to speed limits is mandatory, and the flight plan explicitly prohibits eastward deviations, with non-compliance subject to penalties.

The 05/23 reflight procedure may instruct to maintain an altitude of 900 meters. It isrecommended to consult both the air traffic control (ATC) and air traffic control (ATC) requirements for comprehensive guidance.

When the aircraft'stake-off performance permits, use reduced-thrust takeoff whenever possible.

The aircraft ascends to 1500ft (QNH), adjusting and maintaining engine climb power/thrust at V2+15kt, with flaps and slats kept in takeoff position.

The aircraft transitions to normal climb speed after reaching 3000ft (QNH) during takeoff, then retracts the flaps/sweeps according to the procedure.

Pressure relief procedure: The route between Xiamen and Lanzhou involves pressure reliefoperations.

Radio Failure Procedure: Refer to the Instrument Flight Rules for Aircraft Two-Way Radio Communication Failure Procedure in NAIP General Provisions 3.4.5.

arrival.english_preview:
Under the bridge loading agreement, Xiamen Airport will impose a penalty fee on the company for refusing to use the bridge loading equipment. The crew is required to comply with this requirement.

After landing and separating from aircraft 05, it may sometimes direct aircraft B9, B, or B7 ahead. Note that B7 has no waiting line; it is recommended to maintain a safe distance, as nighttime risks are higher. Alternatively, aircraft 05 may land and wait ahead of aircraft A and B10. B10 has no waiting line and isrelatively close to B11; it is recommended to remain vigilant.

Adjust the M503 route deviation as needed

During idle periods on the Xiamen-Nanyang route, passengers near P326/P306 in Xiamen can request a direct flight to P47. After connecting at P47 to Nanchang, they may apply for a flight to TULMU. When approaching Wuhan, a 6,600-meter descent will be required. After connecting at TULMU to Wuhan XSH, passengers can request a flight to HOK.

For the Xiamen-Changchun route, passengers may request a flight from Dongshan DST to Zhoushan HSN during the outbound leg.

For the Xiamen-Lanzhou route (P36), if the altitude cannot be raised above 7,800 meters before reaching HOK, the Wuhan area will be inaccessible. It is mandatory to maintain low altitude until HOK. Subsequent altitude adjustments will depend on Zhengzhou's instructions. It is mandatory to closely monitor fuel levels.

After the Xiamen-Nanjing and Shanghai regional EMRID, proceed to OLRIS, and ensure route points are checked.

Flights from Xiamen to Shenyang can be scheduled via DST for a 4-minute (approximately 30nm) saving when flying to HSN. After PONAB, direct flights to PINOT are available. Flights to NIXEP can be arranged after VED. Additionally, flights to QO can be requested after FD.

Common Procedures: RNAV Port Entry Procedures

RWY05: When entering from Fuqing FQG, pilots are typically directed to fly directly to Xinglin XLN.

During the 05 approach, maintain the correct course at the five-point approach point without eastward deviation, and strictlycontrol the timing and altitude for passing the outer reference beacon (D4.5XMN) and the XLN (Crossing Point) navigation station. When the airfield islightly trafficked and the tower isoperating autonomously, strictly follow the descent altitude specified in the approach chart. Aircraft entering from the west should promptly slow down and request altitude reduction.

During approach 23, avoid premature four-turn maneuvers. The five sides are flanked by mountains to prevent terrain warnings. Due to topographical constraints, individual entry procedures may require delayed descent; maintain profile control.

The inward shift of the runway entrance may cause visual illusions.

If Runway 05 ILS fails, the crew may initiate RNP 05 approach. Note that the arrival gate number differs. Additionally, when RNP approaches Runway 05 and the AP is disconnected at the minimum descent altitude, the profile tends to be elevated. Control measures: ①Prepare contingency plans in the briefing, and execute a decisive go-around ifan unstable approach occurs; If the drop rate exceeds 1000 feet, the PM must issue a warning. ②During operation, if the altitude profile ishigher than expected after visual check, stabilize the descent point, then check the descent rate. If the rate is within 1000 feet per minute, continue the approach; otherwise, return to the runway. ③ Xiamen now requires that both the covered bridge and passenger elevators must be removed and fully prepared before reporting. On the Xiamen-Nanyang route, the flight sequence may be directed as follows: QO, then P48, followed by P263, JDZ, and finally XSH.

Thunderstorm is restricted in space-time domain.

Track surface characteristics: The terrain ishigher at Runway 05 and lower at Runway 23.

Terrain: The airport is situated at a higher elevation with complex topography. Itsnortheastern end borders the sea at a lower elevation, while the southwestern end adjoins Xiamen Port. Numerous tall artificialstructures in the area significantly impact takeoff and landing operations.

(1) The northeast side of the airport borders Kinmen Island, which is relatively close to this airport and requires strict adherence to flight restrictions specified in the airworthiness chart. There have been frequent GPS signal interference incidents near Xiamen Airport, with other airlines repeatedly issuing GPWS warnings due to GPS signal interference.

The 05/23 reflight procedure may instruct to maintain an altitude of 900 meters. It isrecommended to consult both the air traffic control (ATC) and air traffic control (ATC) requirements for comprehensive guidance.

Pressure relief procedure: The route between Xiamen and Lanzhou involves pressure reliefoperations.

Radio Failure Procedure: Refer to the Instrument Flight Rules for Aircraft Two-Way Radio Communication Failure Procedure in NAIP General Provisions 3.4.5.

Low-temperature correction: In accordance with the company's relevant regulations

Visual approach: The 05 short five-sided visual approach is prohibited (due to terrain turning conditions, simulator verification failed) Japan and South Korea
