core.text_zh: 通讯失效与紧急下降雅加达机场细则以及出离场图中 没有列出具体的通讯失效程序，通常情况下的紧急降落、非法干预、通信失效、拦截和搜索救援程序都与 ICAO附件 和文件要求的建议做法和程序一致。通过上次飞行，雅加达的地面管制指挥比较随意懒散，很多时候不予纠错，需证实。还有，可能是由于新航线的问 题，许多管制员不清楚春秋的呼号，会用 CQH代替 AirSpring，注意识别。
core.text_en: No dedicated lost communication, emergency descent procedures published within Jakarta aerodrome instructions or arrival/departure charts. Standard practices for emergency landing, unlawful interference, communication failure, interception and SAR operations comply with recommended procedures stipulated in ICAO Annexes and relevant documents. Observation from previous sectors: Jakarta Ground Control instructions tend to be informal; controllers often omit error correction, so crews must verify all clearances actively. Due to relatively new route operation, numerous controllers are unfamiliar with Spring Airlines callsign and may use “CQH” in lieu of “AIR SPRING”. Maintain vigilance for correct identification.

core.source_text_zh: 运行特点：通讯失效与紧急下降雅加达机场细则以及出离场图中 没有列出具体的通讯失效程序，通常情况下的紧急降落、非法干预、通信失效、拦截和搜索救援程序都与 ICAO附件 和文件要求的建议做法和程序一致。通过上次飞行，雅加达的地面管制指挥比较随意懒散，很多时候不予纠错，需证实。还有，可能是由于新航线的问 题，许多管制员不清楚春秋的呼号，会用 CQH代替 AirSpring，注意识别。

core.source_text_en: No dedicated lost communication, emergency descent procedures published within Jakarta aerodrome instructions or arrival/departure charts. Standard practices for emergency landing, unlawful interference, communication failure, interception and SAR operations comply with recommended procedures stipulated in ICAO Annexes and relevant documents. Observation from previous sectors: Jakarta Ground Control instructions tend to be informal; controllers often omit error correction, so crews must verify all clearances actively. Due to relatively new route operation, numerous controllers are unfamiliar with Spring Airlines callsign and may use “CQH” in lieu of “AIR SPRING”. Maintain vigilance for correct identification.

core.text_zh: 离开新加坡管制区，在进入到雅加达管制区后，第三 个频率（KIKOR航路点前），会给进场程序代码，有时刚进 雅加达管制区也会给进场程序，但不给跑道信息，通播里 有跑道信息，结合进场指令可以识别落地跑道，后续联系 进近频率时可以证实。
core.text_en: After exiting Singapore FIR and entering Jakarta FIR, arrival procedure designators will normally be issued on the third frequency (prior to waypoint KIKOR). Arrival clearance may occasionally be issued immediately upon entering Jakarta FIR without runway assignment. Runway information is broadcast on DATIS. Crews may identify landing runway by cross-referencing arrival instructions and verify runway when contacting Approach frequency.

core.text_zh: 对于向北落地，07R 对应的只有：AMBOY 2F。06 号 跑道无 AMBOY的进场程序，进港时向东北方向落地，AMBOY方向进港仅有 07R 跑道，通常在刚过新加坡区域后 联系雅加达时给进港方式。距雅加达较近时区调因流量原 因可能会临时指挥改用 06 号跑道，改用 AKSOX 2L 进港，临 时更换跑道和进场方式，导致工作负荷较大，建议在二计 划提前准备。进场程序航路点基本都有高度速度限制，若 无法满足，可申请取消限制。在进场中可会被指挥直飞 （LUVAX，DAKAR 等），后续指挥下降到 4000 尺，可以盲 降进近 07R，建立 final course报告。起始定位点（OLPAS） 高度限制是 5000 尺，遵守起始定位点 OLPAS 的高度限制 5000ft，过点 OLPAS后可以继续下 4000ft。建立航道后有速 度限制：180 节到接地区 8 海里，150 接到接地区 4 海里。
core.text_en: Northbound Arrival Only AMBOY 2M procedure applies to RWY 07R. No AMBOY arrival procedure for RWY 06. For inbound traffic landing northeast, AMBOY arrival exclusively serves RWY 07R; arrival routing is usually advised when contacting Jakarta after passing Singapore FIR. Due to traffic flow, crews operating closer to Jakarta may be rerouted to RWY 06 with AKSOX 2L arrival. Ad-hoc runway and arrival procedure change increases cockpit workload; pre-brief alternate routing in the second flightplan. Altitude and speed constraints are stipulated on most arrival waypoints. Request constraint cancellation if compliance cannot be achieved. ATC may issue direct clearances to waypoints such as LUVAX, DAKAR, followed by descent clearance to 4000 ftfor ILS approach RWY 07R. Report when established on final course. InitialApproach Fix OLPAS altitude limit: 5000 ft. Note that descent to 4000 ftfor ILS may be authorised prior toOLPAS. Speed restrictions after intercepting final course: 180 kt until 8 NM from threshold; 150 ktuntil 4 NM from threshold.

core.text_zh: 对于向南落地，24 号对应 AMBOY 2M 进场，且目前 只有 24 号 RNP 进近。后续进近可以申请 25L 的盲降，若管 制改为 25L ILS进近，引导直飞 UBNUX 点后按程序接 25L ILS，后直飞 UGSEL 4000ft 建立 25L ILS。4.07R 的进场程序 AMBOY 2F 有两个航路点 KAKAP、DAKAR 管制指挥直飞时发音相似，机组注意识别。
core.text_en: Southbound Arrival RWY 24 is served by AMBOY 2M arrival, and only RNP approach is published for RWY 24. Crews may request ILS approach RWY 25L during arrival. If cleared for RWY 25L ILS, vectors direct to UBNUX tojoin published procedure, then direct toUGSEL; maintain 4000 ft tointercept RWY 25L ILS.

core.text_zh: 地形特点：地势南高北低，机场周边 20NM 范围内地 势较为平坦，净空条件良好，南侧 25NM 以外地势较高。网格安全高度为 12300FT，飞行时注意地形影响。
core.text_en: Terrain: Terrain risesfrom north tosouth. The area within 20 NM of the aerodrome is relatively flatwith unobstructed clearance. Terrain elevation increases beyond 25 NM to the south. Grid Minimum Safe Altitude: 12300 FT. Exercise caution regarding terrain during flight.

core.text_zh: 我公司目前只停在 Terminal 3，G12，G13，G14，G18，G19 这几个停机位等，注意的是 G18，G19 进位路线 比较特殊，需谨慎，有时有引导车，有时没有。07R 落地 后，第一个脱离口 S4，脱离后，右转加入 SP2，EC1（此段 有较大的上下坡，注意单发滑行的时机），NP1（一般会在 NC2 前稍等），NC4 进位。地面标识和灯牌标识都比较暗。杰普逊 TAXI 栏中有滑行路线供参考，我司停在 Apron G 区 域，07R 落地参考 10-6F。06 落地参考 10-6N。 25L 参考 10-6J，24 落地参考 10-6R。
core.text_en: After landing RWY 07R: Vacate via firstexit TWY S4. Turn right onto TWY SP2, EC1 (noticeable uphill/downhill gradient on this segment; plan single-engine taxi timing), then NP1 (usually hold short before NC2), NC4 for stand entry. Ground markings and illuminated signs are dim.

english_core.text_en: Departure Taxi (RWY 25R): Apron Control may instruct taxi via unnamed inner taxiway to NC3, hold short of NP1 before handover to Ground Control. Ground Control typical routing: NC3, NP2, holding point RWY 25R. Reminder: Controllers may abbreviate instructions (e.g. “C3, P2” instead of full designators). Identify routing correctly and read back full taxiway designators. When Ground hands over to Tower, listen carefully for instruction “monitor Tower”. Ifadvised to monitor only, maintain listening watch on Tower frequency without initiating contact until called.

english_core.text_en: After exiting Singapore FIR and entering Jakarta FIR, arrival procedure designators will normally be issued on the third frequency (prior to waypoint KIKOR). Arrival clearance may occasionally be issued immediately upon entering Jakarta FIR without runway assignment. Runway information is broadcast on DATIS. Crews may identify landing runway by cross-referencing arrival instructions and verify runway when contacting Approach frequency.

english_core.text_en: Northbound Arrival Only AMBOY 2M procedure applies to RWY 07R. No AMBOY arrival procedure for RWY 06. For inbound traffic landing northeast, AMBOY arrival exclusively serves RWY 07R; arrival routing is usually advised when contacting Jakarta after passing Singapore FIR. Due to traffic flow, crews operating closer to Jakarta may be rerouted to RWY 06 with AKSOX 2L arrival. Ad-hoc runway and arrival procedure change increases cockpit workload; pre-brief alternate routing in the second flightplan. Altitude and speed constraints are stipulated on most arrival waypoints. Request constraint cancellation if compliance cannot be achieved. ATC may issue direct clearances to waypoints such as LUVAX, DAKAR, followed by descent clearance to 4000 ftfor ILS approach RWY 07R. Report when established on final course. InitialApproach Fix OLPAS altitude limit: 5000 ft. Note that descent to 4000 ftfor ILS may be authorised prior toOLPAS. Speed restrictions after intercepting final course: 180 kt until 8 NM from threshold; 150 ktuntil 4 NM from threshold.

无单发离场程序。

跑道 25R，机坪管制会指挥内滑（无标识的滑行道）到 NC3，hold short NP1，交给地面管制，地面管制指挥：NC3，NP2，holding piont25R（上次地面直接省略到 N，直 接说的是 C3，P2，注意识别，回复完整）。后续地面移交 塔台时需仔细听是否为 monitor Tower，如是，转频后不需 联系，等待塔台呼叫即可。

25R 或 07L 离场，分别对应离场程序为：25R DOLTA 2D；07L DOLTA 2A。

25R 离场程序无低的高度限制，只有在走廊口点有 个 FL200 以下的限制，07L 离场程序里有 5000 尺的高度限 制，离地后是否需要取消可向 ATC证实（注意放行里给的 高度一般是 FL280）。

管制员会询问航路点 PARDI 的预计到达时间，由于 口音问题（且 ATC的音量非常小），很难听清楚，ATC：CL TO FL280，EXP FL300，estimated PARDI time。

在沿 NP2 滑行时换频塔台，雅加达塔台管制指令:line up and wait RWY25R，（随意）并未给出具体的滑行道进跑 道，证实后使用 N1 进跑道 25R。N1 跑道等待线距离 NP2 较近，塔台指挥 25R N1 跑道外等可以在 NP2上等待避免 滑过。

滑行道 EC1 上坡坡度较大，若执行单发滑行程序建议 滑过 EC1后再执行。

通讯失效与紧急下降雅加达机场细则以及出离场图中 没有列出具体的通讯失效程序，通常情况下的紧急降落、非法干预、通信失效、拦截和搜索救援程序都与 ICAO附件 和文件要求的建议做法和程序一致。通过上次飞行，雅加达的地面管制指挥比较随意懒散，很多时候不予纠错，需证实。还有，可能是由于新航线的问 题，许多管制员不清楚春秋的呼号，会用 CQH代替 AirSpring，注意识别。

离开新加坡管制区，在进入到雅加达管制区后，第三 个频率（KIKOR航路点前），会给进场程序代码，有时刚进 雅加达管制区也会给进场程序，但不给跑道信息，通播里 有跑道信息，结合进场指令可以识别落地跑道，后续联系 进近频率时可以证实。

对于向北落地，07R 对应的只有：AMBOY 2F。06 号 跑道无 AMBOY的进场程序，进港时向东北方向落地，AMBOY方向进港仅有 07R 跑道，通常在刚过新加坡区域后 联系雅加达时给进港方式。距雅加达较近时区调因流量原 因可能会临时指挥改用 06 号跑道，改用 AKSOX 2L 进港，临 时更换跑道和进场方式，导致工作负荷较大，建议在二计 划提前准备。进场程序航路点基本都有高度速度限制，若 无法满足，可申请取消限制。在进场中可会被指挥直飞 （LUVAX，DAKAR 等），后续指挥下降到 4000 尺，可以盲 降进近 07R，建立 final course报告。起始定位点（OLPAS） 高度限制是 5000 尺，遵守起始定位点 OLPAS 的高度限制 5000ft，过点 OLPAS后可以继续下 4000ft。建立航道后有速 度限制：180 节到接地区 8 海里，150 接到接地区 4 海里。

对于向南落地，24 号对应 AMBOY 2M 进场，且目前 只有 24 号 RNP 进近。后续进近可以申请 25L 的盲降，若管 制改为 25L ILS进近，引导直飞 UBNUX 点后按程序接 25L ILS，后直飞 UGSEL 4000ft 建立 25L ILS。4.07R 的进场程序 AMBOY 2F 有两个航路点 KAKAP、DAKAR 管制指挥直飞时发音相似，机组注意识别。

07L/R、25L/R：均 ILS 或 LOC和 RNP 进近 目前 24 号盲降不工作，持续时间至 202611 月 27 号 （通告中有信息）。

有 DATIS，(有延迟，有时与实际起降方向不一致)进近 时距离本场 200 海里即可接收到语音通播。

06/24 跑道仅用于着陆，如该跑道可用于起飞和着陆会在 通告中说明。

07R 用于落地。

跑道信息：06/24：3000 米长，60 米宽 07L/25R：3600 米长，60 米宽 07R/25L：3660 米长，60 米宽 06：仅 RNP (LNAV/VNAV或 LNAV) 24、07L/R、25L/R：均 ILS 或 LOC和 RNP 进近 目前 24 号盲降不工作，持续时间至 202611 月 27 号 （通告中有信息）。

地形特点：地势南高北低，机场周边 20NM 范围内地 势较为平坦，净空条件良好，南侧 25NM 以外地势较高。网格安全高度为 12300FT，飞行时注意地形影响。

滑行道无中线灯，只有部分交叉口处有中线绿灯，夜 间滑行需特别注意。滑行道代码都是复合代码，字母加字 母组合，或字母加数字组合。机场北侧滑行道首字母为 N，南侧滑行道首字母为 S。

我公司目前只停在 Terminal 3，G12，G13，G14，G18，G19 这几个停机位等，注意的是 G18，G19 进位路线 比较特殊，需谨慎，有时有引导车，有时没有。07R 落地 后，第一个脱离口 S4，脱离后，右转加入 SP2，EC1（此段 有较大的上下坡，注意单发滑行的时机），NP1（一般会在 NC2 前稍等），NC4 进位。地面标识和灯牌标识都比较暗。杰普逊 TAXI 栏中有滑行路线供参考，我司停在 Apron G 区 域，07R 落地参考 10-6F。06 落地参考 10-6N。 25L 参考 10-6J，24 落地参考 10-6R。

位置：位于印度尼西亚首都雅加达以西 20 公里。

跑道信息：06/24：3000 米长，60 米宽 07L/25R：3600 米长，60 米宽 07R/25L：3660 米长，60 米宽 06：仅 RNP (LNAV/VNAV或 LNAV)。

气候特征：属于热带雨林气候，年平均气温为 27° C。

减噪程序无。

无电子放行（需要人工请求语音放行，TOBT前 25 分 钟可申请）。

部分 ATC口音较重（有印度口音），且有时候机组回 复错误的信息，ATC不予纠正，注意证实。
雅加达苏加诺哈达.english_core_preview:
Departure Taxi (RWY 25R): Apron Control may instruct taxi via unnamed inner taxiway to NC3, hold short of NP1 before handover to Ground Control. Ground Control typical routing: NC3, NP2, holding point RWY 25R. Reminder: Controllers may abbreviate instructions (e.g. “C3, P2” instead of full designators). Identify routing correctly and read back full taxiway designators. When Ground hands over to Tower, listen carefully for instruction “monitor Tower”. Ifadvised to monitor only, maintain listening watch on Tower frequency without initiating contact until called.

RWY 25R departure: DOLTA 2D RWY 07L departure: DOLTA 2A DOLTA 2D (RWY 25R) has no low-level altitude constraint; only FL200 restriction at corridor fix.

DOLTA 2A (RWY 07L) incorporates a 5000 ftaltitude restriction after take-off. Crews may confirm with ATC whether cancellation is required (clearance altitude normally FL280 as stated on departure clearance).

Controllers will request estimated time over waypoint PARDI. Poor audio volume and heavy accents often make instruction difficult to comprehend. Typical clearance format: “Cleared to FL280, expect FL300, estimated PARDI time…”

After exiting Singapore FIR and entering Jakarta FIR, arrival procedure designators will normally be issued on the third frequency (prior to waypoint KIKOR). Arrival clearance may occasionally be issued immediately upon entering Jakarta FIR without runway assignment. Runway information is broadcast on DATIS. Crews may identify landing runway by cross-referencing arrival instructions and verify runway when contacting Approach frequency.

Northbound Arrival Only AMBOY 2M procedure applies to RWY 07R. No AMBOY arrival procedure for RWY 06. For inbound traffic landing northeast, AMBOY arrival exclusively serves RWY 07R; arrival routing is usually advised when contacting Jakarta after passing Singapore FIR. Due to traffic flow, crews operating closer to Jakarta may be rerouted to RWY 06 with AKSOX 2L arrival. Ad-hoc runway and arrival procedure change increases cockpit workload; pre-brief alternate routing in the second flightplan. Altitude and speed constraints are stipulated on most arrival waypoints. Request constraint cancellation if compliance cannot be achieved. ATC may issue direct clearances to waypoints such as LUVAX, DAKAR, followed by descent clearance to 4000 ftfor ILS approach RWY 07R. Report when established on final course. InitialApproach Fix OLPAS altitude limit: 5000 ft. Note that descent to 4000 ftfor ILS may be authorised prior to OLPAS. Speed restrictions after intercepting final course: 180 kt until 8 NM from threshold; 150 ktuntil 4 NM from threshold.

Southbound Arrival RWY 24 is served by AMBOY 2M arrival, and only RNP approach is published for RWY 24. Crews may request ILS approach RWY 25L during arrival. If cleared for RWY 25L ILS, vectors direct to UBNUX tojoin published procedure, then direct to UGSEL; maintain 4000 ft tointercept RWY 25L ILS.

Taxiways are not equipped with continuous centreline lights; steady green centreline lights are only installed at selected intersections. Extra vigilance required for night taxiing.

Taxiway designators are compound codes (letter-letteror letter- number combinations). Taxiways on the northern side of aerodrome start with prefix N; taxiways on southern side start with prefix S.

Our airline operates exclusively at Terminal 3, stands G12, G13, G14, G18, G19. Note that stand entry routing for G18 and G19 is unconventional, proceed with caution. Follow-me vehicle may ormay not be available.

After landing RWY 07R: Vacate via firstexit TWY S4. Turn right onto TWY SP2, EC1 (noticeable uphill/downhill gradient on this segment; plan single-engine taxi timing), then NP1 (usually hold short before NC2), NC4 for stand entry. Ground markings and illuminated signs are dim.

Terrain: Terrain risesfrom north tosouth. The area within 20 NM of the aerodrome is relatively flatwith unobstructed clearance. Terrain elevation increases beyond 25 NM to the south. Grid Minimum Safe Altitude: 12300 FT. Exercise caution regarding terrain during flight.

Climate: Tropical rainforest climate; average annual temperature 27°C.

No engine-out departure procedures.

Noise abatement procedures not applicable.

DATIS available; voice broadcast can be received at 200 NM from the aerodrome upon inbound.

No electronic departure clearance. Voice clearance request required; application may be submitted 25 minutes prior to TOBT.

Some ATC controllers have heavy accents (Indian accent). Controllers may not correct crews if incorrect information is transmitted. Always confirm instructions.

Runway Operational Restrictions RWY 06/24 is for landing only. If both takeoff and landing operations are permitted on this runway, relevant information will be published via NOTAM.

When operating on RWY 06 direction: RWY 07R for departures; RWY 07L available for departures and landings. Comply with ATC instructions.

When operating on RWY 24 direction: RWY 25R for departures; RWY 25L available for departures and landings. Comply with ATC instructions.

No dedicated lost communication, emergency descent procedures published within Jakarta aerodrome instructions or arrival/departure charts. Standard practices for emergency landing, unlawful interference, communication failure, interception and SAR operations comply with recommended procedures stipulated in ICAO Annexes and relevant documents.

Observation from previous sectors: Jakarta Ground Control instructions tend to be informal; controllers often omit error correction, so crews must verify all clearances actively.

Due to relatively new route operation, numerous controllers are unfamiliar with Spring Airlines callsign and may use “CQH” in lieu of “AIR SPRING”. Maintain vigilance for correct identification.

Runway Information RWY 06/24: 3000 m long, 60 m wide RWY 07L/25R: 3600 m long, 60 m wide RWY 07R/25L: 3660 m long, 60 m wide RWY 06: RNP only (LNAV/VNAV or LNAV) RWY 24, 07L/R, 25L/R: ILS /LOC or RNP approaches available The ILS facility for RWY 24 isunserviceable until 27 NOV 2026 (refer to relevant NOTAM).

source_records.source_original_text_en: Northbound Arrival Only AMBOY 2M procedure applies to RWY 07R. No AMBOY arrival procedure for RWY 06. For inbound traffic landing northeast, AMBOY arrival exclusively serves RWY 07R; arrival routing is usually advised when contacting Jakarta after passing Singapore FIR. Due to traffic flow, crews operating closer to Jakarta may be rerouted to RWY 06 with AKSOX 2L arrival. Ad-hoc runway and arrival procedure change increases cockpit workload; pre-brief alternate routing in the second flightplan. Altitude and speed constraints are stipulated on most arrival waypoints. Request constraint cancellation if compliance cannot be achieved. ATC may issue direct clearances to waypoints such as LUVAX, DAKAR, followed by descent clearance to 4000 ftfor ILS approach RWY 07R. Report when established on final course. InitialApproach Fix OLPAS altitude limit: 5000 ft. Note that descent to 4000 ftfor ILS may be authorised prior toOLPAS. Speed restrictions after intercepting final course: 180 kt until 8 NM from threshold; 150 ktuntil 4 NM from threshold.

source_records.source_original_text_en: No dedicated lost communication, emergency descent procedures published within Jakarta aerodrome instructions or arrival/departure charts. source_records.text_en: Northbound Arrival Only AMBOY 2M procedure applies to RWY 07R. No AMBOY arrival procedure for RWY 06. For inbound traffic landing northeast, AMBOY arrival exclusively serves RWY 07R; arrival routing is usually advised when contacting Jakarta after passing Singapore FIR. Due to traffic flow, crews operating closer to Jakarta may be rerouted to RWY 06 with AKSOX 2L arrival. Ad-hoc runway and arrival procedure change increases cockpit workload; pre-brief alternate routing in the second flightplan. Altitude and speed constraints are stipulated on most arrival waypoints. Request constraint cancellation if compliance cannot be achieved. ATC may issue direct clearances to waypoints such as LUVAX, DAKAR, followed by descent clearance to 4000 ftfor ILS approach RWY 07R. Report when established on final course. InitialApproach Fix OLPAS altitude limit: 5000 ft. Note that descent to 4000 ftfor ILS may be authorised prior toOLPAS. Speed restrictions after intercepting final course: 180 kt until 8 NM from threshold; 150 ktuntil 4 NM from threshold.

departure.chinese_preview:
无单发离场程序

跑道 25R，机坪管制会指挥内滑（无标识的滑行道）到 NC3，hold short NP1，交给地面管制，地面管制指挥：NC3，NP2，holding piont25R（上次地面直接省略到 N，直接说的是 C3，P2，注意识别，回复完整）。后续地面移交塔台时需仔细听是否为 monitor Tower，如是，转频后不需联系，等待塔台呼叫即可

25R 或 07L 离场，分别对应离场程序为：25R DOLTA 2D；07L DOLTA 2A

25R 离场程序无低的高度限制，只有在走廊口点有个 FL200 以下的限制，07L 离场程序里有 5000 尺的高度限制，离地后是否需要取消可向 ATC证实（注意放行里给的高度一般是 FL280）

管制员会询问航路点 PARDI 的预计到达时间，由于口音问题（且 ATC的音量非常小），很难听清楚，ATC：CL TO FL280，EXP FL300，estimated PARDI time

在沿 NP2 滑行时换频塔台，雅加达塔台管制指令:line up and wait RWY25R，（随意）并未给出具体的滑行道进跑道，证实后使用 N1 进跑道 25R。N1 跑道等待线距离 NP2 较近，塔台指挥 25R N1 跑道外等可以在 NP2上等待避免滑过

滑行道 EC1 上坡坡度较大，若执行单发滑行程序建议滑过 EC1后再执行

通讯失效与紧急下降雅加达机场细则以及出离场图中没有列出具体的通讯失效程序，通常情况下的紧急降落、非法干预、通信失效、拦截和搜索救援程序都与 ICAO附件和文件要求的建议做法和程序一致。通过上次飞行，雅加达的地面管制指挥比较随意懒散，很多时候不予纠错，需证实。还有，可能是由于新航线的问题，许多管制员不清楚春秋的呼号，会用 CQH代替 AirSpring，注意识别

地势南高北低，机场周边 20NM 范围内地势较为平坦，净空条件良好，南侧 25NM 以外地势较高。网格安全高度为 12300FT，飞行时注意地形影响

位置：位于印度尼西亚首都雅加达以西 20 公里

气候特征：属于热带雨林气候，年平均气温为 27° C

减噪程序无

无电子放行（需要人工请求语音放行，TOBT前 25 分钟可申请）

部分 ATC口音较重（有印度口音），且有时候机组回复错误的信息，ATC不予纠正，注意证实
departure.english_preview:
Departure Taxi (RWY 25R): Apron Control may instruct taxi via unnamed inner taxiway to NC3, hold short of NP1 before handover to Ground Control. Ground Control typical routing: NC3, NP2, holding point RWY 25R. Reminder: Controllers may abbreviate instructions (e.g. “C3, P2” instead of full designators). Identify routing correctly and read back full taxiway designators. When Ground hands over to Tower, listen carefully for instruction “monitor Tower”. Ifadvised to monitor only, maintain listening watch on Tower frequency without initiating contact until called.

RWY 25R departure: DOLTA 2D RWY 07L departure: DOLTA 2A DOLTA 2D (RWY 25R) has no low-level altitude constraint; only FL200 restriction at corridor fix.

DOLTA 2A (RWY 07L) incorporates a 5000 ftaltitude restriction after take-off. Crews may confirm with ATC whether cancellation is required (clearance altitude normally FL280 as stated on departure clearance).

Controllers will request estimated time over waypoint PARDI. Poor audio volume and heavy accents often make instruction difficult to comprehend. Typical clearance format: “Cleared to FL280, expect FL300, estimated PARDI time…”

Terrain: Terrain risesfrom north tosouth. The area within 20 NM of the aerodrome is relatively flatwith unobstructed clearance. Terrain elevation increases beyond 25 NM to the south. Grid Minimum Safe Altitude: 12300 FT. Exercise caution regarding terrain during flight.

Climate: Tropical rainforest climate; average annual temperature 27°C.

No engine-out departure procedures.

Noise abatement procedures not applicable.

DATIS available; voice broadcast can be received at 200 NM from the aerodrome upon inbound.

No electronic departure clearance. Voice clearance request required; application may be submitted 25 minutes prior to TOBT.

Some ATC controllers have heavy accents (Indian accent). Controllers may not correct crews if incorrect information is transmitted. Always confirm instructions.

Runway Operational Restrictions RWY 06/24 is for landing only. If both takeoff and landing operations are permitted on this runway, relevant information will be published via NOTAM.

When operating on RWY 06 direction: RWY 07R for departures; RWY 07L available for departures and landings. Comply with ATC instructions.

When operating on RWY 24 direction: RWY 25R for departures; RWY 25L available for departures and landings. Comply with ATC instructions.

No dedicated lost communication, emergency descent procedures published within Jakarta aerodrome instructions or arrival/departure charts. Standard practices for emergency landing, unlawful interference, communication failure, interception and SAR operations comply with recommended procedures stipulated in ICAO Annexes and relevant documents.

Observation from previous sectors: Jakarta Ground Control instructions tend to be informal; controllers often omit error correction, so crews must verify all clearances actively.

Due to relatively new route operation, numerous controllers are unfamiliar with Spring Airlines callsign and may use “CQH” in lieu of “AIR SPRING”. Maintain vigilance for correct identification.

Runway Information RWY 06/24: 3000 m long, 60 m wide RWY 07L/25R: 3600 m long, 60 m wide RWY 07R/25L: 3660 m long, 60 m wide RWY 06: RNP only (LNAV/VNAV or LNAV) RWY 24, 07L/R, 25L/R: ILS /LOC or RNP approaches available The ILS facility for RWY 24 isunserviceable until 27 NOV 2026 (refer to relevant NOTAM).

我公司目前只停在 Terminal 3，G12，G13，G14，G18，G19 这几个停机位等，注意的是 G18，G19 进位路线比较特殊，需谨慎，有时有引导车，有时没有。07R 落地后，第一个脱离口 S4，脱离后，右转加入 SP2，EC1（此段有较大的上下坡，注意单发滑行的时机），NP1（一般会在 NC2 前稍等），NC4 进位。地面标识和灯牌标识都比较暗。杰普逊 TAXI 栏中有滑行路线供参考，我司停在 Apron G 区域，07R 落地参考 10-6F。06 落地参考 10-6N。 25L 参考 10-6J，24 落地参考 10-6R

位置：位于印度尼西亚首都雅加达以西 20 公里

跑道信息：06/24：3000 米长，60 米宽 07L/25R：3600 米长，60 米宽 07R/25L：3660 米长，60 米宽 06：仅 RNP (LNAV/VNAV或 LNAV)

气候特征：属于热带雨林气候，年平均气温为 27° C

减噪程序无

无电子放行（需要人工请求语音放行，TOBT前 25 分钟可申请）

部分 ATC口音较重（有印度口音），且有时候机组回复错误的信息，ATC不予纠正，注意证实
arrival.english_preview:
After exiting Singapore FIR and entering Jakarta FIR, arrival procedure designators will normally be issued on the third frequency (prior to waypoint KIKOR). Arrival clearance may occasionally be issued immediately upon entering Jakarta FIR without runway assignment. Runway information is broadcast on DATIS. Crews may identify landing runway by cross-referencing arrival instructions and verify runway when contacting Approach frequency.

Northbound Arrival Only AMBOY 2M procedure applies to RWY 07R. No AMBOY arrival procedure for RWY 06. For inbound traffic landing northeast, AMBOY arrival exclusively serves RWY 07R; arrival routing is usually advised when contacting Jakarta after passing Singapore FIR. Due to traffic flow, crews operating closer to Jakarta may be rerouted to RWY 06 with AKSOX 2L arrival. Ad-hoc runway and arrival procedure change increases cockpit workload; pre-brief alternate routing in the second flightplan. Altitude and speed constraints are stipulated on most arrival waypoints. Request constraint cancellation if compliance cannot be achieved. ATC may issue direct clearances to waypoints such as LUVAX, DAKAR, followed by descent clearance to 4000 ftfor ILS approach RWY 07R. Report when established on final course. InitialApproach Fix OLPAS altitude limit: 5000 ft. Note that descent to 4000 ftfor ILS may be authorised prior to OLPAS. Speed restrictions after intercepting final course: 180 kt until 8 NM from threshold; 150 ktuntil 4 NM from threshold.

Southbound Arrival RWY 24 is served by AMBOY 2M arrival, and only RNP approach is published for RWY 24. Crews may request ILS approach RWY 25L during arrival. If cleared for RWY 25L ILS, vectors direct to UBNUX tojoin published procedure, then direct to UGSEL; maintain 4000 ft tointercept RWY 25L ILS.

Taxiways are not equipped with continuous centreline lights; steady green centreline lights are only installed at selected intersections. Extra vigilance required for night taxiing.

Taxiway designators are compound codes (letter-letteror letter- number combinations). Taxiways on the northern side of aerodrome start with prefix N; taxiways on southern side start with prefix S.

Our airline operates exclusively at Terminal 3, stands G12, G13, G14, G18, G19. Note that stand entry routing for G18 and G19 is unconventional, proceed with caution. Follow-me vehicle may ormay not be available.

After landing RWY 07R: Vacate via firstexit TWY S4. Turn right onto TWY SP2, EC1 (noticeable uphill/downhill gradient on this segment; plan single-engine taxi timing), then NP1 (usually hold short before NC2), NC4 for stand entry. Ground markings and illuminated signs are dim.

Terrain: Terrain risesfrom north tosouth. The area within 20 NM of the aerodrome is relatively flatwith unobstructed clearance. Terrain elevation increases beyond 25 NM to the south. Grid Minimum Safe Altitude: 12300 FT. Exercise caution regarding terrain during flight.

Climate: Tropical rainforest climate; average annual temperature 27°C.

Noise abatement procedures not applicable.

DATIS available; voice broadcast can be received at 200 NM from the aerodrome upon inbound.

Some ATC controllers have heavy accents (Indian accent). Controllers may not correct crews if incorrect information is transmitted. Always confirm instructions.

Runway Operational Restrictions RWY 06/24 is for landing only. If both takeoff and landing operations are permitted on this runway, relevant information will be published via NOTAM.

When operating on RWY 06 direction: RWY 07R for departures; RWY 07L available for departures and landings. Comply with ATC instructions.

When operating on RWY 24 direction: RWY 25R for departures; RWY 25L available for departures and landings. Comply with ATC instructions.

No dedicated lost communication, emergency descent procedures published within Jakarta aerodrome instructions or arrival/departure charts. Standard practices for emergency landing, unlawful interference, communication failure, interception and SAR operations comply with recommended procedures stipulated in ICAO Annexes and relevant documents.

Observation from previous sectors: Jakarta Ground Control instructions tend to be informal; controllers often omit error correction, so crews must verify all clearances actively.

Due to relatively new route operation, numerous controllers are unfamiliar with Spring Airlines callsign and may use “CQH” in lieu of “AIR SPRING”. Maintain vigilance for correct identification.

Runway Information RWY 06/24: 3000 m long, 60 m wide RWY 07L/25R: 3600 m long, 60 m wide RWY 07R/25L: 3660 m long, 60 m wide RWY 06: RNP only (LNAV/VNAV or LNAV) RWY 24, 07L/R, 25L/R: ILS /LOC or RNP approaches available The ILS facility for RWY 24 isunserviceable until 27 NOV 2026 (refer to relevant NOTAM).

core.text_zh: 10 号跑道盲降进近，受地形影响，下滑角为 3.3°。五边航向道为 100°，跑道方向为 103°，存在 3°差异。地形在五边 3 海里处，建议机组保持 航道，2 海里再断开 AP 修正至跑道中心延长线，避免过早对正跑道中心延 长线产生地形影响的风险。机组断开 AP 后，应忽略航道偏移，参考 GS。
core.text_en: For ILS approach RWY10, terrain imposes a 3.3° glidepath. Final localiser course is 100°, runway heading 103°, creating a 3° difference. Terrain islocated at 3 NM on final.It is recommended that crews maintain localiser track, disconnect AP at 2 NM to correct towards runway centreline extension. Avoid early alignment with runway centreline extension to mitigate terrain risk. After AP disconnection, disregard localiser offset and reference GS.

core.text_zh: 大连机场 RWY10 偏置 ILS 进近避免“Glide Slope”警戒的操作建议：大连机场 10 号盲降，有 3°偏置，通过模拟机验证，决断高度以后，继 续沿航图公布的 3.3°下滑角进近，飞机将以 50ft 通过跑道入口，受偏 置影响，G/S 信号显示会逐渐上移（指示飞机低于下滑道），验证飞机在 不同高度的 G/S 信号显示，如下图。综上所述，在执行 10 号盲降进近 时，RA200ft 以下，应参考 PAPI 指示灯及下降率指示继续保持 3.3°下 滑角至通过跑道入口。机组应意识到，当下滑道显示存在较大偏差时，意 味着下滑剖面异常。同时，因跑道入口内移，易产生偏高的视觉误差，因 此应避免因视觉误差而盲目增大下降率。
core.text_en: Operational guidance to avoid Glide Slope alert for offset ILS approach RWY10 at Dalian Airport: The ILS for RWY10 features a 3° offset. Simulator validation confirms that continuing the published 3.3° glidepath after decision height will result in crossing runway threshold at 50 ft. Owing to the offset, G/S indication gradually shifts upward (showing aircraft below glideslope). G/S indications at various altitudes are shown in the attached diagram. In summary, during ILS approach RWY10, below RA200 ft,crews shall reference PAPI and descent rate indication to maintain the 3.3° glidepath until crossing runway threshold. Crews shall recognise that substantial glideslope deviation indicates abnormal descent profile. Meanwhile, displaced runway threshold may create visual high-approach illusion; refrain from increasing descent rate solely due to visual cues.

english_core.text_en: For ILS approach RWY10, terrain imposes a 3.3° glidepath. Final localiser course is 100°, runway heading 103°, creating a 3° difference. Terrain islocated at 3 NM on final.It is recommended that crews maintain localiser track, disconnect AP at 2 NM to correct towards runway centreline extension. Avoid early alignment with runway centreline extension to mitigate terrain risk. After AP disconnection, disregard localiser offset and reference GS.

english_core.text_en: Operational guidance to avoid Glide Slope alert for offset ILS approach RWY10 at Dalian Airport: The ILS for RWY10 features a 3° offset. Simulator validation confirms that continuing the published 3.3° glidepath after decision height will result in crossing runway threshold at 50 ft. Owing to the offset, G/S indication gradually shifts upward (showing aircraft below glideslope). G/S indications at various altitudes are shown in the attached diagram. In summary, during ILS approach RWY10, below RA200 ft,crews shall reference PAPI and descent rate indication to maintain the 3.3° glidepath until crossing runway threshold. Crews shall recognise that substantial glideslope deviation indicates abnormal descent profile. Meanwhile, displaced runway threshold may create visual high-approach illusion; refrain from increasing descent rate solely due to visual cues.

english_core.text_en: Restriction for second approach after go-around: If reported crosswind component (including gust) ≥15 m/s and a low-altitude go-around (below 1000 ft AGL) occurs due to turbulence, a second approach on the same runway is prohibited ifreported crosswind component (including gust) remains ≥15 m/s. If reported crosswind component (including gust) ＜15 m/s and a low-altitude go-around (below 1000 ft AGL) occurs due to turbulence, a second approach on the same runway ispermitted if reported crosswind component (including gust) remains ＜ 15 m/s. A further approach shall not be attempted after a second go-around. (Reference OM 8.2.11)

english_core.text_en: Engine ice shedding procedure: This procedure may only be performed at designated locations and shall not be initiated without authorisation. Before execution, crews shall notify Ground or Tower atfirst contact using fixed format: “Flight number + engine ice shedding required + latest ice shedding time”. Execution can only commence after Tower approval. Controllers shall not combine ice shedding clearance with take-off clearance; separate explicit approval for ice shedding must be issued and crew readback confirmed. Even if performed on runway, ice shedding acceleration segment and take-off acceleration segment must be fully separated with independent readbacks to guard against unauthorised take-off.

大连周水子.chinese_core_preview:
推出后飞机位置位于机坪内未命名的滑行线上，滑出直接加入 A，机组参考 地面滑行线加入 A，注意加强观察。

28号跑道头有多个联络道可进入跑道，ATC 有时会指挥在盲降等待点等待，机组应听清指令，避免滑错或造成跑道侵入。

根据大连机场细则要求 航空器的滑行速度不得超过 50km/h，在障碍物附 近滑行时速度应该减到 15km/h 以下。

离场可能使用 CCO（连续爬升）离场，机组按离场图要求执行。

10号跑道起飞时，不要接通 LS 按钮。由于航向道与跑道存在 3°偏差（五 边航向道 100°、跑道方向 103°），能见度较低时若接通 ILS 参考航道 会产生偏差。

28号跑道起飞，一边侧方有小山，机组须注意阅读离场图注释中的离场爬 升梯度限制，确保满足越障梯度要求。

进近会根据本场流量指挥直飞，直飞后通常下降剖面较陡，机组应提前做 好能量管理。

大连如果执行 PMS 程序，飞机较少时会较早指挥直飞：28 号直飞 TL307、10 号直飞 TL111，加入扇形排序的航空器在弧上飞行速度 230 kt。

使用 28 号跑道时，需在 DOBGA 之前确定进港方式，因为不同进场程序在 过 DOBGA 后航迹不同。

青岛方向管制可能指挥飞 ORIXA（该点不在航路上），使用 ORIXA-07A（或 ORIXA-17A/19A）进场程序，飞机较少时可能会指挥直飞 TL105/TL309，注 意做好能量管理。

10号盲降五边 3 海里处注意北侧有较高地形。

10 号跑道盲降进近，受地形影响，下滑角为 3.3°。五边航向道为 100°，跑道方向为 103°，存在 3°差异。地形在五边 3 海里处，建议机组保持 航道，2 海里再断开 AP 修正至跑道中心延长线，避免过早对正跑道中心延 长线产生地形影响的风险。机组断开 AP 后，应忽略航道偏移，参考 GS。

大连机场 RWY10 偏置 ILS 进近避免“Glide Slope”警戒的操作建议：大连机场 10 号盲降，有 3°偏置，通过模拟机验证，决断高度以后，继 续沿航图公布的 3.3°下滑角进近，飞机将以 50ft 通过跑道入口，受偏 置影响，G/S 信号显示会逐渐上移（指示飞机低于下滑道），验证飞机在 不同高度的 G/S 信号显示，如下图。综上所述，在执行 10 号盲降进近 时，RA200ft 以下，应参考 PAPI 指示灯及下降率指示继续保持 3.3°下 滑角至通过跑道入口。机组应意识到，当下滑道显示存在较大偏差时，意 味着下滑剖面异常。同时，因跑道入口内移，易产生偏高的视觉误差，因 此应避免因视觉误差而盲目增大下降率。

10/28 号跑道入口均有内移，注意判断跑道入口位置，同时注意可能产生 的目视剖面高的错觉。

如实施目视进近，须特别注意 10 号五边北侧地形，保持目视参考与越障裕 度。

北侧有较高地形，10号五边 3 海里处有地形。

受季风和地形影响，大连机场大风和乱流明显，五边出现颠簸较多，风切变 高发，机组应提前做好稳定进近，关注风向风速的变化，跑道入口时提前控 制好飞机下沉和收油门时机，遇到风切变时果断复飞。

特殊复杂程序：10 号跑道盲降不可用时可能使用 RNP AR 程序，机组须注 意机组搭配资质要求，确保具备相应授权与签注。

季风气候：因季风气候易发生突发侧风，导致拉平坡度大，机组在拉平阶段 须加强横侧操纵，遇超限风险果断复飞或复飞后再次进近。

跑道入口内移、目视与盲降偏置及信号不稳定易触发 Glide Slope 警告，机组须熟知 10 号跑道偏置航道、大下滑角（3.3°）及 28 号跑道视觉错 觉问题，警惕地形乱流、侧风，严防 CFIT、重着陆、冲偏跑道。

根据大连监管局《关于防控大连周水子国际机场 CFIT（可控飞行撞地）、冲偏出跑道、重着陆风险航空安全通告》要求，机组应：。

熟知本场特殊风险：牢记 10 号跑道偏置航道、大下滑角及 28 号跑道视觉 错觉问题，警惕地形乱流、侧风，严防 CFIT、重着陆、冲偏跑道。

规范机组协同操作：严格执行稳定进近标准，用好 CRM 管理，落实标准喊 话、交叉互检，及时识别处置飞行威胁与差错。

做好天气预判与预案：密切关注雷雨、低能见、风切变预警，航前充分评估 风险，提前制定备降方案，异常情况果断复飞。

28 号跑道落地后，塔台指挥脱离并跟引导车到位后报告；但脱离道口位置 常停有多辆引导车，机组需提前辨认，防止与引导车冲突。严格控制进位速 度，防止过线。

地面滑行时间较短，机组需注意关车前慢车 3 分钟限制。

227-229 号机位运行方式由“自滑进顶推出”变更为“自滑进自滑出”，新 增3 条机位引入线（227-229 机位滑出线），废除一条顶推线（227 机位顶 推线）废除 1 个推出等待点（227D）。

PAPI 信息：10：跑道左侧内移入口内 320m，3.3°，MEHT 16.3m；28：跑道左侧内 移入口内 302m，3°，MEHT 14.7m。

二类操纵类复杂机场。

是否为繁忙机场 否。

强化空地沟通配合：主动向管制通报飞机状态、机组决策，保证信息传递准 确，提升空地协同防控风险能力。

直飞 KAE。

After pushback, the aircraftstands on an unnamed taxiway within the apron. Taxi out tojoin Taxiway A directly. Crews shall refer to surface taxi markings to join Taxiway A and maintain enhanced lookout.

Multiple taxiway connectors lead to RWY28 threshold. ATC may assign hold at ILS holding point. Crews shall listen carefully to clearances to avoid taxi deviation or runway incursion.

CCO (Continuous Climb Operation) departures may be applied. Crews shall comply with requirements on departure charts.

Do not engage LS button for take-off from RWY10. A 3° offset exists between localiser and runway (final localiser course 100°, runway heading 103°). Engagement of ILS reference course under reduced visibility will introduce course deviation.

A small hillexists abeam upwind leg for RWY28 take-off. It is required to read climb gradient restrictions stated in notes on departure charts and ensure obstacle-clearance gradient compliance.

ATC may assign direct routing according to traffic volume. Such direct routing usually results in steep descent profile; crews shallmanage energy in advance.

When executing PMS procedure at Dalian, direct routing may be issued early under light traffic: direct to TL307 for RWY28, direct to TL111 for RWY10. Aircraft joining fan sequencing shall maintain 230 kt on the arc.

For RWY28 operations, arrival type shall be determined prior to DOBGA, as different arrival procedures follow divergent tracks after passing DOBGA.

Qingdao sector control may assign routing via ORIXA (waypoint not on published route), applying ORIXA-07A (orORIXA-17A/19A) arrival procedure. Under light traffic, direct routing to TL105/TL309 may be cleared. Perform energy management accordingly.

High terrain to the north exists at 3 NM on the ILS final of RWY10.

For ILS approach RWY10, terrain imposes a 3.3° glidepath. Final localiser course is 100°, runway heading 103°, creating a 3° difference. Terrain is located at 3 NM on final. It is recommended that crews maintain localiser track, disconnect AP at 2 NM to correct towards runway centreline extension. Avoid early alignment with runway centreline extension to mitigate terrain risk. After AP disconnection, disregard localiser offset and reference GS.

Operational guidance to avoid Glide Slope alert for offset ILS approach RWY10 at Dalian Airport: The ILS for RWY10 features a 3° offset. Simulator validation confirms that continuing the published 3.3° glidepath after decision height will result in crossing runway threshold at 50 ft. Owing to the offset, G/S indication gradually shifts upward (showing aircraft below glideslope). G/S indications at various altitudes are shown in the attached diagram. In summary, during ILS approach RWY10, below RA200 ft, crews shall reference PAPI and descent rate indication to maintain the 3.3° glidepath until crossing runway threshold. Crews shall recognise that substantial glideslope deviation indicates abnormal descent profile. Meanwhile, displaced runway threshold may create visual high-approach illusion; refrain from increasing descent rate solely due to visual cues.

Both RWY10 and RWY28 have displaced thresholds. Identify threshold position carefully and be alert to potential visual high-profile illusion.

If visual approach is conducted, pay special attention to terrain north of RWY10 final, maintain visual references and obstacle clearance margin.

After landing RWY28, Tower will clear exit and request report after positioning with follow-me car. Multiple follow-me vehicles may park at exit taxiways. It is required to identify in advance to prevent conflict with follow-me cars. Strictly control the carry speed to prevent crossing the line.

Ground taxi time is relatively short. Observe the 3-minute idle run requirement prior to engine shutdown.

The operation mode of stands 227-229 is changed from "taxi-in and push-back out" to "taxi-in and taxi-out". Three new stand lead-in taxiways (taxi-out taxiways for stands 227-229) are added, one push-back taxiway (push-back taxiway for stand 227) is abolished, and one push-back holding point (227D) isremoved.

Runway Information: 10/28 (3300 m × 45 m)

PAPI Information: RWY10: 320 m inside displaced threshold on the left side of runway, 3.3°, MEHT 16.3 m; RWY28: 302 m inside displaced threshold on the left side of runway, 3°, MEHT 14.7 m.

Night operations: Special taxiway layout combined with inadequate night lighting increases risk of runway incursion. Crews shall strengthen runway incursion prevention and carefully identify holding lines and junctions.

Affected by monsoon and terrain, Dalian Airport experiences strong winds, significant turbulence, frequent bumpy rides on final and high windshear risk. Crews shall establish stable approach in advance, monitor wind speed and direction variation, control sink rate and throttle reduction timing near threshold. Execute timely go-around upon windshear encounter.

Special complex procedure: RNP AR procedure may be used when ILS RWY10 is unavailable. It is required to verify crew pairing qualification and hold valid authorisation and endorsement.

Monsoon climate: Sudden crosswinds may occur, leading to large bank angle during flare. Enhance lateral control in flare phase; execute go-around promptly when exceedance risk exists, or conduct another approach after go-around.

Restriction for second approach after go-around: If reported crosswind component (including gust) ≥15 m/s and a low-altitude go-around (below 1000 ft AGL) occurs due to turbulence, a second approach on the same runway is prohibited ifreported crosswind component (including gust) remains ≥15 m/s. If reported crosswind component (including gust) ＜15 m/s and a low-altitude go-around (below 1000 ft AGL) occurs due to turbulence, a second approach on the same runway ispermitted if reported crosswind component (including gust) remains ＜ 15 m/s. A further approach shall not be attempted after a second go-around. (Reference OM 8.2.11)

Displaced runway thresholds, visual/ILS offset and unstable signals may trigger Glide Slope alert. It is required to be familiar with offset localiser, steep glidepath (3.3°) for RWY10 and visual illusion for RWY28. Stay vigilant of terrain turbulence and crosswinds, and strictly prevent CFIT, hard landing, runway excursion and overrun.

Engine ice shedding procedure: This procedure may only be performed at designated locations and shall not be initiated without authorisation. Before execution, it is required to notify Ground or Tower atfirst contact using fixed format: “Flight number + engine ice shedding required + latest ice shedding time”. Execution can only commence after Tower approval. Controllers shall not combine ice shedding clearance with take-off clearance; separate explicit approval for ice shedding must be issued and crew readback confirmed. Even if performed on runway, ice shedding acceleration segment and take-off acceleration segment must be fully separated with independent readbacks to guard against unauthorised take-off.

Dalian Airport engine ice shedding procedure isshown inthe attached diagram.

Ramp / Dispatch Frequency: 132.0 MHz

In accordance with Aviation Safety Notice issued by Dalian CAAC Sub-Administration Regarding Risk Prevention of CFIT, Runway Excursion and Hard Landing at Dalian Zhoushuizi International Airport, crews shall:

Be familiar with local specific hazards: memorise RWY10 offset localiser and steep glidepath, RWY28 visual illusion; stay alert to terrain turbulence and crosswinds, strictly prevent CFIT, hard landing and runway excursion.

Standardise crew coordination: strictly adhere to stable approach criteria, utilise CRM, implement standard callouts and cross-checks, promptly recognise and mitigate flight threats and errors.

Strengthen air-ground communication: proactively report aircraft status and crew decisions to ATC, ensure accurate information transmission and improve air-ground collaborative risk control.

Conduct weather assessment and contingency planning: closely monitor thunderstorm, low visibility and windshear alerts; fully evaluate risks pre-flight, prepare diversion plan and initiate go-around decisively under abnormal conditions.

source_records.source_original_text_en: Operational guidance to avoid Glide Slope alert for offset ILS approach RWY10 at Dalian Airport: The ILS for RWY10 features a 3° offset. Simulator validation confirms that continuing the published 3.3° glidepath after decision height will result in crossing runway threshold at 50 ft. Owing to the offset, G/S indication gradually shifts upward (showing aircraft below glideslope). G/S indications at various altitudes are shown in the attached diagram. In summary, during ILS approach RWY10, below RA200 ft,crews shall reference PAPI and descent rate indication to maintain the 3.3° glidepath until crossing runway threshold. Crews shall recognise that substantial glideslope deviation indicates abnormal descent profile. Meanwhile, displaced runway threshold may create visual high-approach illusion; refrain from increasing descent rate solely due to visual cues.

source_records.text_zh: 进场：大连机场 RWY10 偏置 ILS 进近避免“Glide Slope”警戒的操作建议：大连机场 10 号盲降，有 3°偏置，通过模拟机验证，决断高度以后，继 续沿航图公布的 3.3°下滑角进近，飞机将以 50ft 通过跑道入口，受偏 置影响，G/S 信号显示会逐渐上移（指示飞机低于下滑道），验证飞机在 不同高度的 G/S 信号显示，如下图。综上所述，在执行 10 号盲降进近 时，RA200ft 以下，应参考 PAPI 指示灯及下降率指示继续保持 3.3°下 滑角至通过跑道入口。机组应意识到，当下滑道显示存在较大偏差时，意 味着下滑剖面异常。同时，因跑道入口内移，易产生偏高的视觉误差，因 此应避免因视觉误差而盲目增大下降率。

source_records.source_original_text: 运行特点：复飞后再次进近的限制：当报告的侧风分量(含阵风)超过 15m/s(含)时，如因湍流导致低高度(1000ftAGL 以下)复飞，若报告的侧风分量(含阵风)仍 超过 15m/s(含)，不允许使用同一跑道再次进近；当报告的侧风分量(含阵 风)小于 15m/s(不含)时，如因湍流导致低高度(1000ftAGL 以下)复飞，若 报告的侧风分量(含阵风)仍小于 15m/s(不含）允许使用同一跑道实施再次 进近;若再次复飞，则不得再次进近。（参考运行手册 8.2.11）。

source_records.source_original_text_en: Engine ice shedding procedure: This procedure may only be performed at designated locations and shall not be initiated without authorisation. Before execution, crews shall notify Ground or Tower atfirst contact using fixed format: “Flight number + engine ice shedding required + latest ice shedding time”. Execution can only commence after Tower approval. Controllers shall not combine ice shedding clearance with take-off clearance; separate explicit approval for ice shedding must be issued and crew readback confirmed. Even if performed on runway, ice shedding acceleration segment and take-off acceleration segment must be fully separated with independent readbacks to guard against unauthorised take-off.

source_records.text_en: Operational guidance to avoid Glide Slope alert for offset ILS approach RWY10 at Dalian Airport: The ILS for RWY10 features a 3° offset. Simulator validation confirms that continuing the published 3.3° glidepath after decision height will result in crossing runway threshold at 50 ft. Owing to the offset, G/S indication gradually shifts upward (showing aircraft below glideslope). G/S indications at various altitudes are shown in the attached diagram. In summary, during ILS approach RWY10, below RA200 ft,crews shall reference PAPI and descent rate indication to maintain the 3.3° glidepath until crossing runway threshold. Crews shall recognise that substantial glideslope deviation indicates abnormal descent profile. Meanwhile, displaced runway threshold may create visual high-approach illusion; refrain from increasing descent rate solely due to visual cues.

source_records.text_en: Restriction for second approach after go-around: If reported crosswind component (including gust) ≥15 m/s and a low-altitude go-around (below 1000 ft AGL) occurs due to turbulence, a second approach on the same runway is prohibited ifreported crosswind component (including gust) remains ≥15 m/s. If reported crosswind component (including gust) ＜15 m/s and a low-altitude go-around (below 1000 ft AGL) occurs due to turbulence, a second approach on the same runway ispermitted if reported crosswind component (including gust) remains ＜ 15 m/s. A further approach shall not be attempted after a second go-around. (Reference OM 8.2.11)

source_records.text_en: Engine ice shedding procedure: This procedure may only be performed at designated locations and shall not be initiated without authorisation. Before execution, crews shall notify Ground or Tower atfirst contact using fixed format: “Flight number + engine ice shedding required + latest ice shedding time”. Execution can only commence after Tower approval. Controllers shall not combine ice shedding clearance with take-off clearance; separate explicit approval for ice shedding must be issued and crew readback confirmed. Even if performed on runway, ice shedding acceleration segment and take-off acceleration segment must be fully separated with independent readbacks to guard against unauthorised take-off.

english_candidates.text: Operational guidance to avoid Glide Slope alert for offset ILS approach RWY10 at Dalian Airport: The ILS for RWY10 features a 3° offset. Simulator validation confirms that continuing the published 3.3° glidepath after decision height will result in crossing runway threshold at 50 ft. Owing to the offset, G/S indication gradually shifts upward (showing aircraft below glideslope). G/S indications at various altitudes are shown in the attached diagram. In summary, during ILS approach RWY10, below RA200 ft,crews shall reference PAPI and descent rate indication to maintain the 3.3° glidepath until crossing runway threshold. Crews shall recognise that substantial glideslope deviation indicates abnormal descent profile. Meanwhile, displaced runway threshold may create visual high-approach illusion; refrain from increasing descent rate solely due to visual cues.

english_candidates.text: Engine ice shedding procedure: This procedure may only be performed at designated locations and shall not be initiated without authorisation. Before execution, crews shall notify Ground or Tower atfirst contact using fixed format: “Flight number + engine ice shedding required + latest ice shedding time”. Execution can only commence after Tower approval. Controllers shall not combine ice shedding clearance with take-off clearance; separate explicit approval for ice shedding must be issued and crew readback confirmed. arrival.chinese_preview:
进近会根据本场流量指挥直飞，直飞后通常下降剖面较陡，应提前做好能量管理

大连如果执行 PMS 程序，飞机较少时会较早指挥直飞：28 号直飞 TL307、10 号直飞 TL111，加入扇形排序的航空器在弧上飞行速度 230 kt

使用 28 号跑道时，需在 DOBGA 之前确定进港方式，因为不同进场程序在过 DOBGA 后航迹不同

青岛方向管制可能指挥飞 ORIXA（该点不在航路上），使用 ORIXA-07A（或 ORIXA-17A/19A）进场程序，飞机较少时可能会指挥直飞 TL105/TL309，注意做好能量管理

10号盲降五边 3 海里处注意北侧有较高地形

10 号跑道盲降进近，受地形影响，下滑角为 3.3°。五边航向道为 100°，跑道方向为 103°，存在 3°差异。地形在五边 3 海里处，建议机组保持航道，2 海里再断开 AP 修正至跑道中心延长线，避免过早对正跑道中心延长线产生地形影响的风险。机组断开 AP 后，应忽略航道偏移，参考 GS

大连机场 RWY10 偏置 ILS 进近避免“Glide Slope”警戒的操作建议：大连机场 10 号盲降，有 3°偏置，通过模拟机验证，决断高度以后，继续沿航图公布的 3.3°下滑角进近，飞机将以 50ft 通过跑道入口，受偏置影响，G/S 信号显示会逐渐上移（指示飞机低于下滑道），验证飞机在不同高度的 G/S 信号显示，如下图。综上所述，在执行 10 号盲降进近时，RA200ft 以下，应参考 PAPI 指示灯及下降率指示继续保持 3.3°下滑角至通过跑道入口。应意识到，当下滑道显示存在较大偏差时，意味着下滑剖面异常。同时，因跑道入口内移，易产生偏高的视觉误差，因此应避免因视觉误差而盲目增大下降率

10/28 号跑道入口均有内移，注意判断跑道入口位置，同时注意可能产生的目视剖面高的错觉

如实施目视进近，须特别注意 10 号五边北侧地形，保持目视参考与越障裕度

北侧有较高地形，10号五边 3 海里处有地形

受季风和地形影响，大连机场大风和乱流明显，五边出现颠簸较多，风切变高发，应提前做好稳定进近，关注风向风速的变化，跑道入口时提前控制好飞机下沉和收油门时机，遇到风切变时果断复飞

10 号跑道盲降不可用时可能使用 RNP AR 程序，机组须注意机组搭配资质要求，确保具备相应授权与签注

季风气候：因季风气候易发生突发侧风，导致拉平坡度大，在拉平阶段须加强横侧操纵，遇超限风险果断复飞或复飞后再次进近

跑道入口内移、目视与盲降偏置及信号不稳定易触发 Glide Slope 警告，机组须熟知 10 号跑道偏置航道、大下滑角（3.3°）及 28 号跑道视觉错觉问题，警惕地形乱流、侧风，严防 CFIT、重着陆、冲偏跑道

根据大连监管局《关于防控大连周水子国际机场 CFIT（可控飞行撞地）、冲偏出跑道、重着陆风险航空安全通告》要求，应：

熟知本场特殊风险：牢记 10 号跑道偏置航道、大下滑角及 28 号跑道视觉错觉问题，警惕地形乱流、侧风，严防 CFIT、重着陆、冲偏跑道

规范机组协同操作：严格执行稳定进近标准，用好 CRM 管理，落实标准喊话、交叉互检，及时识别处置飞行威胁与差错

做好天气预判与预案：密切关注雷雨、低能见、风切变预警，航前充分评估风险，提前制定备降方案，异常情况果断复飞

28 号跑道落地后，塔台指挥脱离并跟引导车到位后报告；但脱离道口位置常停有多辆引导车，机组需提前辨认，防止与引导车冲突。严格控制进位速度，防止过线

地面滑行时间较短，需注意关车前慢车 3 分钟限制

227-229 号机位运行方式由“自滑进顶推出”变更为“自滑进自滑出”，新增3 条机位引入线（227-229 机位滑出线），废除一条顶推线（227 机位顶推线）废除 1 个推出等待点（227D）

28号跑道头有多个联络道可进入跑道，ATC 有时会指挥在盲降等待点等待，应听清指令，避免滑错或造成跑道侵入

根据大连机场细则要求航空器的滑行速度不得超过 50km/h，在障碍物附近滑行时速度应该减到 15km/h 以下

PAPI 信息：10：跑道左侧内移入口内 320m，3.3°，MEHT 16.3m；28：跑道左侧内移入口内 302m，3°，MEHT 14.7m

二类操纵类复杂机场

是否为繁忙机场否

强化空地沟通配合：主动向管制通报飞机状态、机组决策，保证信息传递准确，提升空地协同防控风险能力

arrival.english_preview:
Multiple taxiway connectors lead to RWY28 threshold. ATC may assign hold at ILS holding point. Crews shall listen carefully to clearances to avoid taxi deviation or runway incursion.

ATC may assign direct routing according to traffic volume. Such direct routing usually results in steep descent profile; crews shallmanage energy in advance.

When executing PMS procedure at Dalian, direct routing may be issued early under light traffic: direct to TL307 for RWY28, direct to TL111 for RWY10. Aircraft joining fan sequencing shall maintain 230 kt on the arc.

For RWY28 operations, arrival type shall be determined prior to DOBGA, as different arrival procedures follow divergent tracks after passing DOBGA.

Qingdao sector control may assign routing via ORIXA (waypoint not on published route), applying ORIXA-07A (orORIXA-17A/19A) arrival procedure. Under light traffic, direct routing to TL105/TL309 may be cleared. Perform energy management accordingly.

High terrain to the north exists at 3 NM on the ILS final of RWY10.

For ILS approach RWY10, terrain imposes a 3.3° glidepath. Final localiser course is 100°, runway heading 103°, creating a 3° difference. Terrain is located at 3 NM on final. It is recommended that crews maintain localiser track, disconnect AP at 2 NM to correct towards runway centreline extension. Avoid early alignment with runway centreline extension to mitigate terrain risk. After AP disconnection, disregard localiser offset and reference GS.

Operational guidance to avoid Glide Slope alert for offset ILS approach RWY10 at Dalian Airport: The ILS for RWY10 features a 3° offset. Simulator validation confirms that continuing the published 3.3° glidepath after decision height will result in crossing runway threshold at 50 ft. Owing to the offset, G/S indication gradually shifts upward (showing aircraft below glideslope). G/S indications at various altitudes are shown in the attached diagram. In summary, during ILS approach RWY10, below RA200 ft, crews shall reference PAPI and descent rate indication to maintain the 3.3° glidepath until crossing runway threshold. Crews shall recognise that substantial glideslope deviation indicates abnormal descent profile. Meanwhile, displaced runway threshold may create visual high-approach illusion; refrain from increasing descent rate solely due to visual cues.

Both RWY10 and RWY28 have displaced thresholds. Identify threshold position carefully and be alert to potential visual high-profile illusion.

If visual approach is conducted, pay special attention to terrain north of RWY10 final, maintain visual references and obstacle clearance margin.

After landing RWY28, Tower will clear exit and request report after positioning with follow-me car. Multiple follow-me vehicles may park at exit taxiways. It is required to identify in advance to prevent conflict with follow-me cars. Strictly control the carry speed to prevent crossing the line.

Ground taxi time is relatively short. Observe the 3-minute idle run requirement prior to engine shutdown.

The operation mode of stands 227-229 is changed from "taxi-in and push-back out" to "taxi-in and taxi-out". Three new stand lead-in taxiways (taxi-out taxiways for stands 227-229) are added, one push-back taxiway (push-back taxiway for stand 227) is abolished, and one push-back holding point (227D) isremoved.

Runway Information: 10/28 (3300 m × 45 m)

PAPI Information: RWY10: 320 m inside displaced threshold on the left side of runway, 3.3°, MEHT 16.3 m; RWY28: 302 m inside displaced threshold on the left side of runway, 3°, MEHT 14.7 m.

Night operations: Special taxiway layout combined with inadequate night lighting increases risk of runway incursion. Crews shall strengthen runway incursion prevention and carefully identify holding lines and junctions.

Affected by monsoon and terrain, Dalian Airport experiences strong winds, significant turbulence, frequent bumpy rides on final and high windshear risk. Crews shall establish stable approach in advance, monitor wind speed and direction variation, control sink rate and throttle reduction timing near threshold. Execute timely go-around upon windshear encounter.

Special complex procedure: RNP AR procedure may be used when ILS RWY10 is unavailable. It is required to verify crew pairing qualification and hold valid authorisation and endorsement.

Monsoon climate: Sudden crosswinds may occur, leading to large bank angle during flare. Enhance lateral control in flare phase; execute go-around promptly when exceedance risk exists, or conduct another approach after go-around.

Restriction for second approach after go-around: If reported crosswind component (including gust) ≥15 m/s and a low-altitude go-around (below 1000 ft AGL) occurs due to turbulence, a second approach on the same runway is prohibited ifreported crosswind component (including gust) remains ≥15 m/s. If reported crosswind component (including gust) ＜15 m/s and a low-altitude go-around (below 1000 ft AGL) occurs due to turbulence, a second approach on the same runway ispermitted if reported crosswind component (including gust) remains ＜ 15 m/s. A further approach shall not be attempted after a second go-around. (Reference OM 8.2.11)

Displaced runway thresholds, visual/ILS offset and unstable signals may trigger Glide Slope alert. It is required to be familiar with offset localiser, steep glidepath (3.3°) for RWY10 and visual illusion for RWY28. Stay vigilant of terrain turbulence and crosswinds, and strictly prevent CFIT, hard landing, runway excursion and overrun.

Dalian Airport engine ice shedding procedure isshown inthe attached diagram.

Ramp / Dispatch Frequency: 132.0 MHz

In accordance with Aviation Safety Notice issued by Dalian CAAC Sub-Administration Regarding Risk Prevention of CFIT, Runway Excursion and Hard Landing at Dalian Zhoushuizi International Airport, crews shall:

Be familiar with local specific hazards: memorise RWY10 offset localiser and steep glidepath, RWY28 visual illusion; stay alert to terrain turbulence and crosswinds, strictly prevent CFIT, hard landing and runway excursion.

Standardise crew coordination: strictly adhere to stable approach criteria, utilise CRM, implement standard callouts and cross-checks, promptly recognise and mitigate flight threats and errors.

Strengthen air-ground communication: proactively report aircraft status and crew decisions to ATC, ensure accurate information transmission and improve air-ground collaborative risk control.

Conduct weather assessment and contingency planning: closely monitor thunderstorm, low visibility and windshear alerts; fully evaluate risks pre-flight, prepare diversion plan and initiate go-around decisively under abnormal conditions.

english_core.text_en: Taxi-through (idle) de-icing: Taxi to the de-icing position near the RWY 24 threshold. After the follow-me car departs, stop by observing the stop line on your own — it ishard to see atnight or when covered with snow. Contact the de-icing controller if the position is uncertain. Crews should complete de-icing/anti-icing preparations, maintain the de-icing configuration, and contact the de-icing controller. The taxiway centerline lights on the de-icing pad are hard to observe — be careful while taxiing. The holdover time for taxi-through de-icing may be short; time the de-icing appropriately and monitor the takeoff time.

离港时管制员可能指挥在 L-H4，A 前等待，A 滑行道前无等待线，须注意留 足距离，避免滑错产生冲突。

24 号通常使用 LEMOT-9D 离场 06 号使用 LEMOT-3D 或 LEMOT-4D 离场。

24 号离场 ATC 可能要求 CC503 前上到 1500m，但 CC503 为 06 号进近的 IF 点，24 号离场程序中无此点，请机组注意，可考虑使用 FIX INFO 功能输入 该点作为参考。

空域受限制时，06 号跑道使用 LEMOT-4A 进场，管制指挥下高度偏晚，可能 造成高截获，机组注意。

06号跑道进近时，因其他用户活动，有时要求保持 2100m 至 DME15 海里，请机组提前做好高截获预案，提前减速、放形态。须特别注意，避免 1000 英尺未稳定。

24 号跑道进场通常指挥 LEMOT-9A（也可能 LEMOT-7A、LEMOT-8A 进场），并直飞 CC455 或 CC608；天气寒冷时管制可能会指挥下 1000 米建立 24 号 盲降。

当从 LEMOT 或 IDVOT 方向进场时，管制发布 LEMOT-9A 进场指令，MCDU 显示 为 LEMO9A，请机组正确复诵，不要复诵成 LEMOT-09A，以减少因管制纠正 指令而占用波道。

NDB 进近曾出现机载数据库位置偏差及收不到 NDB 信号的情况，请机组做 好飞行准备与预案。

RNP 进近时因 ATC 指挥直飞，易使 FDP 点前未达到航图限制高度；待命 APPR 后可能导致无法截获 FINAL APP，请机组注意剖面管理。

跑道东低西高，坡度明显，24 号跑道上坡坡度 0.5%和 0.7%，06 号跑道下 坡坡度 0.5%和 0.7%，注意对着陆目视的影响，尤其下午 24 号着陆向阳。

长春 RWY06 ILS/DME Z 决断高度调整为 DA（H）296（80）米，980（270） 英尺，请注意。

风切变风险：机场曾发生风切变导致复飞事件，机组须识别相关风险，做好 复飞准备。

长春龙嘉.english_core_preview:
During departure, ATC may instruct holding short of Taxiway A at L-H4; there is no holding position marking before Taxiway A. Leave sufficient distance to avoid taxi errors and conflicts.

During taxi-through (idle) de-icing, the de-icing controller guides the aircraft into position. Identify the stand and the stop line, and be especially cautious atnight or when covered with snow.

RWY 24 normally uses the LEMOT-9D departure; RWY 06 uses the LEMOT-3D or LEMOT-4D departure.

On RWY 24 departures, ATC may require reaching 1,500 m before CC503. However, CC503 is the IF for the RWY 06 approach and is not included in the RWY 24 departure procedure. It is recommended to be aware, and may consider entering this point via the FIX INFO function for reference.

When airspace is restricted, RWY 06 uses the LEMOT-4A arrival; ATC often clears the descent late, which may resultin a high interception — crews should be aware.

On RWY 06 approaches, due to other users' activity, ATC sometimes requires maintaining 2,100 m until15 nm DME. Prepare inadvance for ahigh interception — slow down and configure early. Pay special attention to avoiding being unstable at 1,000 ft.

RWY 24 arrivals areusually cleared via the LEMOT-9A (or possibly LEMOT-7A /LEMOT-8A), with direct-to CC455 or CC608. In cold weather, ATC may clear a descent to 1,000 m to establish the RWY 24 ILS.

When arriving from the LEMOT or IDVOT direction, ATC issues the LEMOT- 9A arrival; the MCDU displays it as"LEMO9A." Read back correctly and do not read back "LEMOT-09A," so as to reduce frequency occupancy caused by ATC corrections.

During NDB approaches, cases of onboard database position error and failure to receive the NDB signal have occurred; crews should make proper preparations and plans.

In the radio navigation and landing aids section of the aerodrome regulations, the DME ident isIPP for RWY 24 and IDD for RWY 06.

On RNP approaches, ATC direct-toclearances may easily resultin failing to meet the charted altitude constraint before the FDP; after arming APPR, failure to capture FINAL APP may occur. Crews should manage the vertical profile carefully.

The runway islower at the east end and higher at the west end, with a noticeable gradient: RWY 24 has upslope gradients of 0.5% and 0.7%, and RWY 06 has downslope gradients of 0.5% and 0.7%. Be aware of the effect on visual references during landing, especially on RWY 24 in the afternoon when landing into the sun.

Vacate the runway via arapid-exit taxiway as soon as possible after landing.

Runway data: 06/24 (3,200 m × 45 m)

PAPI data: RWY 06 — 472 m beyond the leftrunway threshold,3°, MEHT 20.4m; RWY 24 — 400 m beyond the rightrunway threshold,3°, MEHT 21.2 m.

Taxi-through (idle) de-icing: Taxi to the de-icing position near the RWY 24 threshold. After the follow-me car departs, stop by observing the stop line on your own — it ishard to see atnight or when covered with snow. Contact the de-icing controller if the position is uncertain. It is recommended to complete de-icing/anti-icing preparations, maintain the de-icing configuration, and contact the de-icing controller. The taxiway centerline lights on the de-icing pad are hard to observe — be careful while taxiing. The holdover time for taxi-through de-icing may be short; time the de-icing appropriately and monitor the takeoff time.

Wind shear risk: Wind-shear-induced go-arounds have occurred at this airport. It is mandatory to identify the associated risks and be prepared for go-around.

Ground/dispatch frequency: 132.0; taxi-through de-icing frequency: 121.825 (subject to the aerodrome regulations and ground control).

On airway A588, after P388, Dalian (ATC) may clear CHI–DBL–MAKNO — prepare in advance.

Historical Safety Events：Wind shear, unstable approaches, bird strikes and other risks require continued attention. It is recommended to prepare contingency plans and be ready for go-around. Southeast Asia

The holdover time for taxi-through de-icing may be short; time the de-icing appropriately and monitor the takeoff time.

arrival.chinese_preview:
空域受限制时，06 号跑道使用 LEMOT-4A 进场，管制指挥下高度偏晚，可能造成高截获，注意

06号跑道进近时，因其他用户活动，有时要求保持 2100m 至 DME15 海里，请提前做好高截获预案，提前减速、放形态。须特别注意，避免 1000 英尺未稳定

24 号跑道进场通常指挥 LEMOT-9A（也可能 LEMOT-7A、LEMOT-8A 进场），并直飞 CC455 或 CC608；天气寒冷时管制可能会指挥下 1000 米建立 24 号盲降

当从 LEMOT 或 IDVOT 方向进场时，管制发布 LEMOT-9A 进场指令，MCDU 显示为 LEMO9A，请机组正确复诵，不要复诵成 LEMOT-09A，以减少因管制纠正指令而占用波道

NDB 进近曾出现机载数据库位置偏差及收不到 NDB 信号的情况，请机组做好飞行准备与预案

RNP 进近时因 ATC 指挥直飞，易使 FDP 点前未达到航图限制高度；待命 APPR 后可能导致无法截获 FINAL APP，请注意剖面管理

跑道东低西高，坡度明显，24 号跑道上坡坡度 0.5%和 0.7%，06 号跑道下坡坡度 0.5%和 0.7%，注意对着陆目视的影响，尤其下午 24 号着陆向阳

长春 RWY06 ILS/DME Z 决断高度调整为 DA（H）296（80）米，980（270） 英尺，请注意

风切变风险：机场曾发生风切变导致复飞事件，机组须识别相关风险，做好复飞准备

落地后应尽快选择快速脱离道脱离跑道

离港时管制员可能指挥在 L-H4，A 前等待，A 滑行道前无等待线，须注意留足距离，避免滑错产生冲突

基础信息

132.0；慢车除冰频率：121.825（以机场细则及现场指挥为准）

ZYCC—ZBSJ：数据库对外开放航路 G212 上 TGO 至 UKDUM 之间缺少 P528（该点为不对外开放航路点），会造成航迹偏差，请注意

A588 航路，P388 后，大连可能指挥 CHI-DBL-MAKNO，请提前做好准备

PAPI信息：06：跑道左侧入口内 472m，3°，MEHT 20.4m；24：跑道右侧入口内 400m，3°，MEHT 21.2m
arrival.english_preview:
During taxi-through (idle) de-icing, the de-icing controller guides the aircraft into position. Identify the stand and the stop line, and be especially cautious atnight or when covered with snow.

When airspace is restricted, RWY 06 uses the LEMOT-4A arrival; ATC often clears the descent late, which may resultin a high interception — crews should be aware.

On RWY 06 approaches, due to other users' activity, ATC sometimes requires maintaining 2,100 m until15 nm DME. Prepare inadvance for ahigh interception — slow down and configure early. Pay special attention to avoiding being unstable at 1,000 ft.

RWY 24 arrivals areusually cleared via the LEMOT-9A (or possibly LEMOT-7A /LEMOT-8A), with direct-to CC455 or CC608. In cold weather, ATC may clear a descent to 1,000 m to establish the RWY 24 ILS.

When arriving from the LEMOT or IDVOT direction, ATC issues the LEMOT- 9A arrival; the MCDU displays it as"LEMO9A." Read back correctly and do not read back "LEMOT-09A," so as to reduce frequency occupancy caused by ATC corrections.

During NDB approaches, cases of onboard database position error and failure to receive the NDB signal have occurred; crews should make proper preparations and plans.

In the radio navigation and landing aids section of the aerodrome regulations, the DME ident isIPP for RWY 24 and IDD for RWY 06.

On RNP approaches, ATC direct-toclearances may easily resultin failing to meet the charted altitude constraint before the FDP; after arming APPR, failure to capture FINAL APP may occur. Crews should manage the vertical profile carefully.

The runway islower at the east end and higher at the west end, with a noticeable gradient: RWY 24 has upslope gradients of 0.5% and 0.7%, and RWY 06 has downslope gradients of 0.5% and 0.7%. Be aware of the effect on visual references during landing, especially on RWY 24 in the afternoon when landing into the sun.

Vacate the runway via arapid-exit taxiway as soon as possible after landing.

Runway data: 06/24 (3,200 m × 45 m)

PAPI data: RWY 06 — 472 m beyond the leftrunway threshold,3°, MEHT 20.4m; RWY 24 — 400 m beyond the rightrunway threshold,3°, MEHT 21.2 m.

Wind shear risk: Wind-shear-induced go-arounds have occurred at this airport. It is mandatory to identify the associated risks and be prepared for go-around.

Ground/dispatch frequency: 132.0; taxi-through de-icing frequency: 121.825 (subject to the aerodrome regulations and ground control).

On airway A588, after P388, Dalian (ATC) may clear CHI–DBL–MAKNO — prepare in advance.

Historical Safety Events：Wind shear, unstable approaches, bird strikes and other risks require continued attention. It is recommended to prepare contingency plans and be ready for go-around. Southeast Asia

groups.chinese_preview:
我是来自飞行十五中队的副驾驶段洋硕，目前技术级别A2，晋级日期1月13日，本阶段经历时间93小时，起落21个，近90天起落8个，近3个月已运行过广州白云机场，近3个月已运行过曼谷素旺那普机场，上一次实际操纵落地为10月1日上海浦东机场。

上一次飞行中机长/教员对我优缺点的评价（作为PF/PM各取最近一次）：
上一次作为PF教员评价：30尺以下带杆量欠一点；着陆后快速脱离道口前及时减速至30节以下；作为PM机长评价：增加SOP熟练度，标准喊话声音大一些。

典型不安全事件：

广州白云机场：

该机场曾发生，鸟击，风切变，飞错离场事件，请机组注意识别相关风险。

曼谷素旺那普机场：

受地面温度影响，易发生进近剖面低，着陆距离远等事件，请机组注意。

核心威胁：

广州白云机场：

离港滑行路线为“YELLOW”,进港滑行路线为“GREEN ”。

广州机位919R 不建议单发滑行。

yellow11滑行线在Q到T61,Q和M滑行路线很近，没有地面标识，滑行时注意观察避免滑错。

滑行道换向，摒弃旧滑行惯性，严防逆行。

运行方向切换时仔细听通播，留意跑道、滑行道状态, 飞行准备务必复习本场新滑行路线。

无需复诵PDC。

飞行员每次滑行前应当事先熟悉具体滑行路线编号代表的进离港标准滑行路线。

跑道运行规则：向北运行：RWYO1L主要用于进场；RWYO1R 主要用于离场；RWYO2L主要用于离场；RWYO2R 主要用于进场；RWY03进、离场混合运行。向南运行：RWY19R 主要用于进场；RWY19L 主要用于离场；RWY20R 主要用于离场；RWY20L 主要用于进场；RWY21 进、离场混合运行。

02L跑道起飞时地面常指挥T61在Y19前等，由于绕滑的滑行道设计特殊性，中方航图与杰普逊AMM航图标识有差异，杰普逊AMM航图标识Y19标识不显示，有时会误导机组T61 前方的滑行道是Y20完成右转才是Y19，经与地面管制证实如果发布T61在Y19前等，需要在T61上等待，避免错过等待线。

广州T3，939附近机位，管制给推出指令，可以推开，推到R3，跑道01R。机务可能只推到大概正对838到939 之间的位置。这个时候应提醒机务往前拉一点，尽量满足推到R3上。因R3，R4，R5连接处有点滑行区域没有标注，在推出过程中管制指令和机务行为有时候不够统一，务必多留心。建议设计特定推出程序，或者给出明确清晰推出指令。

绕滑距离变长，起飞前预留充足地面滑行时间。

注意根据fly Smart修改单发加速高度。

广州涉及航线距离较长，飞机起飞重量大，从T3滑行至01R/19L地面滑行时间长，且道面坡度起伏和转弯多，易造成刹车温度高，导致航班延误或起飞后机轮温度超限情况，请注意。

离地后自动脱波联系进近，具体频率由放行给出。

SID中如有速度限制，可尝试申请取消，否则应遵循。

东南亚方向离场可能指挥直飞P50加入X66临时航路到BIGRO。

早出港航班需参考实际通播和放行按需选择离场跑道。

广州早出港航班，向北起飞，有时管制指挥使用跑道 02R起飞。需要穿越跑道02L，需要注意穿越跑道之后正对着的是P13并不是02R跑道头。Y18为跑道02R跑道等待点，转向 Y时需要注意，Y18并非为Y尽头，注意滑行速度，避免滑过。

杰普逊航图里没有单发离港程序，需要提醒外籍参考 EFB航图。

外籍广州机场特点中，标注单发程序还未启用，需要修改现在已开始执行单发程序，参照EFB航图。

夏秋季有台风影响，带来大范围的强风、暴雨、雷暴天气。

E/F/D/T3/T4为高冲突区，加强观察，指令及时复诵确认。

机场繁忙且相邻机场较多，严格遵守管制指挥，避免造成冲突。

新程序调整，多个程序更名，限制高度涉及更改，注意参阅航图对照MCDU数据。

机场新建跑道容易产生看错、对错、落错等跑道混淆风险，请注意观察，落实标准喊话和交叉检查，尤其是低能见、降雨、夜航等条件下，保持警惕， 严防跑道混淆。

广州机场跑道01L/R、02L/R、03从06.11日起开始实施单发程序，请注意。

曼谷素旺那普机场：

RNAV进场。

雷达水平间隔最小5nm，在 BKKTMA、BKKCTR和素万那普 ATZ内，间隔可能减小到 3nm。

航图新增Z 进近程序为主用程序，数据库也有变化，提示机组注意阅读对应进场图中Warning 中的说明，避免未经 ATC 许可转向五边加入进近程序。

执行 VTBS 20R RNP 进近需要注意。ATKIN 之后转 5 边的航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165,intercept final course 20R,report established.”注意管制是要求先建立20R RNP 的五边，而不是许可 RNP 进近,注意证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以 RNP20R，容易造成能量大，注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP 进近不允许执行“高截获”程序。

02L进近常指挥保持3 边航向，控制前后机距离，之后指挥直飞BATEM 或ABVER，在引入02LRNP 进近计划时MCDU会提示选择VIA BATEM 如果没有选择VIA 计划上看不到BATEM 点。

02L落地后使用F W 跑道外等，使用W 穿越跑道Straight ahead D4 换频 121.95会直接给停机位和滑行路线例如 S123 D 滑行 G 前等，继续滑行 T18 或 T19 进位。机场细则中规定：02L/20R落地后不允许在快速脱离道停留去等待滑行指令，若无指令，02L 落地后应延 F、W、02R 外等，20R 落地后应延 F、Z、20L外等。

我司常停在Satellite-1 卫星厅-1，素万那普有PDC，确认PDC 之后无需复诵，直接联系地面请求推开指令。停机位对应的地面频率可以在AMM 图上看到。

ILS Z 01 BS690 mandatory 1600 RNP 02L BS670 mandatory 1600 ILS Z 19 BS790 mandatory 1600 RNP 20R BS770 mandatory 1600。

三跑道运行，原01R/19L,跑道更名为 01/19跑道，原01L/19R 跑道更名为02R/20L 跑道。第三跑道02L/20R 将会作为非精密进近跑道使用，可以使用RNP 进近程序。

南面进出港:19 用于起飞和落地，20L 用于起飞，20R 用于落地。北面进出港:01用于起飞和落地，02R 用于起飞，02L用于落地。

曼谷进近只给出进场STAR 程序，不告知跑道，虽然通波只告知一条进近跑道，但仍有可能使用通波没有列出的跑道，机组建立五边之前务必证实跑道和进近方式。

SVB 台因迁移长期不工作，已无 VOR 进近程序，盲降测距仪与跑道头位置有误差，避免不稳定。

本机场实施 RNP 进近程序期间，ATC 指挥可能与程序设计逻辑存在差异，请以公司飞行操作通告为准。

如预计经过沥青道面，不建议单发滑行。

滑行道不平整如果 N1-50%时仍无法滑出，需要拖车。

BANGKOKBLUEPORT(BANG-KOKBLUEPORT)，频率129.050，如果我们的机组人员在素万那普机场有任何疑问，例如需要TOBT/TSAT/停机位方面的信息，或者需要飞行计划方面的协助，或需要提出特殊要求，请通过此频率联系他们。

为防止可能的干扰，对离港飞机，直到收到进入或者对正跑道指令才打开 TCAS；对于进港飞机，直到脱离跑道再关闭。

H6与 H3,H5与 H2为同一条滑行道注意识别。

在加油的时候，素万那普机场要求不要上客。如果必须在加油的时候上客，要先通知机场准备消防车。具体可询问春秋机务！。

有减噪程序，除非影响飞行安全，在1900-2300UTC时间内不得使用大反推。

曼谷的 s126机位的进位引导经常跳变，会出现瞬间从 2 米调到 0 然后出现 stop，ok 后又会跳变出数字，有滑过或者未滑行到位的风险，机组和机务都多次遇到此类情况。

巡航时在曼谷区域，近期多触发 NAV ADS-B RPTG 1+2 FAULT,NAV BKUP SPD FAULT，随后出现两侧GPS PRIMARYLOST，应当提前熟知技术通告，飞行全过程中知晓最低安全高度，按技术通告处理。

通讯失效后按航图或机场细则执行。

空域异常繁忙，间隔较小，可能加入等待与标准等待或有出入注意证实。

军演频繁，常涉及改航路，请对照飞行计划检查。

减噪程序：见机场细则。

释压程序：见放行单。

无线电失效程序：机场细则及杰普逊手册有具体实施方法。
